BlastingDung.name: Blasting Dung

AlienFuse.name: Alien Fuse
AlienFuse.description: An alien electrical component that appears unstable.

CorruptedAlloy.name: Corrupted Alloy
CorruptedAlloy.description: An alloy of foreboding matter that feels hollow yet dense.

AncientCoin.name: Ancient Coin
AncientCoin.description: Valuable ancient coin, currency of the underground.

LarvaBossCrystal.name: Ghorm's Horn
LarvaBossCrystal.description: A pointy gemstone that let a larva grow way beyond its maximum size.

SlimeBossCrystal.name: Glurch Eye
SlimeBossCrystal.description: A bulbous gemstone that fused many slimes together into a giant one.

HiveBossCrystal.name: Stolen Crystal Heart
HiveBossCrystal.description: A giant ancient gemstone that mutated its holder into a monstrosity. It originally belonged to the Hive Mother, but was ripped out by a power-hungry caveling.

SlimeBossSummoningItem.name: Giant Slime Summoning Idol
SlimeBossSummoningItem.description: Crystal idol to reawaken a Giant Slime. Consumed upon placing it on any Giant Slime summoning rune.

LarvaBossSummoningItem.name: Ghorm Summoning Idol
LarvaBossSummoningItem.description: Crystal idol to reawaken Ghorm the Devourer. Consumed upon placing it on Ghorm's summoning rune.

HiveBossSummoningItem.name: Hive Mother Summoning Idol
HiveBossSummoningItem.description: Crystal idol to reawaken the Hive Mother. Consumed upon placing it on the Hive Mother's summoning rune.

ShamanBossSummoningItem.name: Malugaz Summoning Idol
ShamanBossSummoningItem.description: A reforged crystal skull that whispers ancient chants. It urges you to place it on the throne room sigil.

KingSlimeSummoningItem.name: Crown Summoning Idol
KingSlimeSummoningItem.description: A crystal idol that feels out of this world. Consumed upon placing it on any Giant Slime summoning rune.

HiveHalloweenBossSummoningItem.name: Haunted Hive Mother Summoning Idol
HiveHalloweenBossSummoningItem.description: Crystal idol to reawaken the Haunted Hive Mother. Consumed upon placing it on the Hive Mother's summoning rune.

CoreBossSummoningItem.name: Core Commander Summoning Idol
CoreBossSummoningItem.description: Crystal idol to reawaken the Core Commander. Consumed upon placing it on the Core Commander's summoning rune.

WallBossSummoningItem.name: Primeval Slime Cell
WallBossSummoningItem.description: A highly mutative, crystalized cell. To resummon Urschleim, activate it in the Passage where ancient lifeforms still roam. Consumed in the process.

GiantCicadaBossSummoningItem.name: Corrupted Sap
GiantCicadaBossSummoningItem.description: A hardened lump of corrupted sap, oozing void-like trails that cling and writhe. Consumed upon placing it on the Giant Cicada summoning rune.

NatureCicadaSummoningItem.name: Hardened Sap
NatureCicadaSummoningItem.description: This hardened hunk of sap lures bugs, small or gigantic, out of the ground! Just place it down and wait.

VoidNeuronCicada.name: Brood Void Neuron
VoidNeuronCicada.description: A glowing cell that phases through itself, twisted and pulled as if tethered to an unseen presence. Born of Nimruza's parasite, fused with Core-linked tissue, it carries a warped signal that may unseal what even the Core Network could not contain.

RobotBossSummoningItem.name: Profane Override
RobotBossSummoningItem.description: A keycard with intricately carved sigils between its circuits. Maybe it stores something beyond mere data?

YellowFirefly.name: Yellow Glowbug

BlueFireFly.name: Blue Glowbug

GreenFireFly.name: Green Glowbug

AncientHologramPod.name: Ancient Hologram Pod
AncientHologramPod.description: A strange device that materializes spirits of the past.

SantasLittleHelper.name: Little Helperling
SantasLittleHelper.description: A fellow caveling that fits in your backpack but wants to be placed down soon because it's eager to work. It will craft presents in exchange for cooked food, give it rare cooked food for higher quality!

MysteriousIdol.name: Mysterious Idol
MysteriousIdol.description: A crystalline core statue. May attract someone looking for mysterious idols if placed in a habitable room.

SlimeOil.name: Slime Oil Idol
SlimeOil.description: A jar filled with slime essence, used for beard care. Place it in a habitable room and a bearded character may move in.

PileOfChum.name: Pile of Chum Idol
PileOfChum.description: Undigested remains of prey that could double down as food for fish. Place it in a habitable room and a character interested in fishing may move in.

CookiesAndMilk.name: Cookies & Milk
CookiesAndMilk.description: To trade with the one that decides who is naughty and who is nice.

Calendar.name: Seasonal Calendar
Calendar.description: A useful calendar that will attract a shady merchant when placed in a habitable room. Depending on the season, he will put on different costumes and offer new items.

CrystalMerchantSpawnItem.name: Nuclear Battery Idol
CrystalMerchantSpawnItem.description: A highly advanced piece of technology that stores nuclear energy. When placed in a habitable room, it will attract a bold traveler of the Shimmering Frontier.

VoidMerchantIdol.name: Void Idol
VoidMerchantIdol.description: A thorny statue of alien-looking make. Place it in a habitable room and an otherworldly visitor may move in.

AncientFountain.name: Ancient Fountain
AncientFountain.description: Only those with secret knowledge know where to find this fountain. It is powered by an ammonite fossil that crystalized through the presence of ancient gemstones.

GlassFloor.name: Glass Floor
GlassFloor.description: A see-through tile to provide a crystal-clear vision of the ground underneath.

ThinWallGlass.name: Thin Glass Wall
ThinWallGlass.description: A thin wall made from glass, perfect to create enclosures.

GlassBridge.name: Glass Bridge
GlassBridge.description: A transparent bridge that has no supports and that can be built across water or chasms.

WovenStrawFloor.name: Woven Straw Floor
WovenStrawFloor.description: A reinforced floor, woven from meadow straw.

GleamWoodFloor.name: Gleam Wood Floor
GleamWoodFloor.description: An enigmatic floor decorated with patterned tiles.

GleamWoodFenceGate.name: Gleam Wood Fence Gate
GleamWoodFenceGate.description: A pale, elegant gate for the gleam wood fence.

GleamWoodFence.name: Gleam Wood Fence
GleamWoodFence.description: A pale, elegant fence for keeping your base safe.

GleamWoodBridge.name: Gleam Wood Bridge
GleamWoodBridge.description: An enigmatic bridge that floats in space and that can be built across water or chasms.

Rug.name: Rug
Rug.description: Cover up the cold ground and make your base cozy.

WovenMat.name: Woven Mat
WovenMat.description: Groundcover made from a net of firm plants.

LooseFlooring.name: Loose Flooring
LooseFlooring.description: A collection of workable groundcover made from clay. A true hobbyist might turn them into different shapes and colors.

ValentineFloorPetals.name: Rose Petal Flooring
ValentineFloorPetals.description: This little paper bag contains enough rose petals to cover a 1x1 floor tile with them. Great to lay out a path of love.

Bed.name: Bed
Bed.description: A place to sleep. Also allows friendly inhabitants to move in if placed in a room to their liking.

WoodDoor.name: Wood Door
WoodDoor.description: Close up your base with this simple door.

StoneDoor.name: Stone Door
StoneDoor.description: A sturdier door to block out unwanted creatures.

ScarletDoor.name: Scarlet Door
ScarletDoor.description: A reinforced door to shut out anyone uninvited.

MetalGrateBridge.name: Metal Grate
MetalGrateBridge.description: A metal bridge that was used to cross lava in the molten quarry.

GleamWoodDoor.name: Gleam Wood Door
GleamWoodDoor.description: An unyielding door to keep adversaries at bay.

CoralDoor.name: Coral Door
CoralDoor.description: A neat door made of colorful organic materials.

GalaxiteDoor.name: Galaxite Door
GalaxiteDoor.description: An otherworldly and nearly indestructible door.

Tapestry.name: Tapestry
Tapestry.description: A sheet of fabric that can be hung on walls.

Banner.name: Banner
Banner.description: A tall, wooden frame with a sheet of fabric hanging down from the top.

LampPost.name: Lamp Post
LampPost.description: A tall bright lit pillar clad in brass, fitting for illuminating dark liminal paths.

SirenLamp.name: Siren Lamp
SirenLamp.description: A durable lamp designed for simple alert systems underground.

WallLightBulb.name: Wall Light Bulb
WallLightBulb.description: The sophisticated alternative to decorative torches.

ExcavationBridge.name: Industrial Bridge
ExcavationBridge.description: Its supporting beams seem intended to withstand cargo of immeasurable weight.

PuzzleDoor.name: Obsidian Door
PuzzleDoor.description: A door made of perplexingly hardened obsidian.

PuzzleDoorKey.name: Obsidian Key
PuzzleDoorKey.description: A sharp key cast in obsidian. There should be a lock somewhere that it fits into.

PuzzleDoorLocked.name: Locked Obsidian Door
PuzzleDoorLocked.description: A door made of perplexingly hardened obsidian. It could be opened with the right key.

CavelingSkull.name: Caveling Skull
CavelingSkull.description: Remains of what was once a proud civilization.

LeafFossil.name: Leaf Fossil
LeafFossil.description: Proof of a once flourishing environment.

Ammonite.name: Ammonite
Ammonite.description: The petrified shell of an ancient sea creature.

Geode.name: Geode
Geode.description: Half of a rock with beautiful crystals inside.

OldAmulet.name: Old Amulet
OldAmulet.description: Brittle stone jewelry. Too small to be worn by a human.

EarPlate.name: Ear Plate
EarPlate.description: A squarish earring plated with gold.

BoneCreole.name: Bone Creole
BoneCreole.description: A crude piece of jewelry carved from bone.

TriangleTrinket.name: Triangle Trinket
TriangleTrinket.description: A strange gold piece vibrating with energy.

TwistedAgate.name: Twisted Agate
TwistedAgate.description: A green gem shaped like a spiral.

BloodSkull.name: Blood Skull
BloodSkull.description: The crimson remains of someone meeting a terrible fate.

GrubKnot.name: Grub Knot
GrubKnot.description: A mutated lump of small grubs. Disgusting.

PetrifiedEgg.name: Petrified Egg
PetrifiedEgg.description: Fossilized egg shell, it feels light and brittle.

OldSporeMask.name: Old Spore Mask
OldSporeMask.description: An old mask protecting against air-borne spores. It's broken but may still fetch a good price.

HardThorn.name: Hard Thorn
HardThorn.description: A sturdy wooden thorn that can quickly poke careless fingers.

BalloonSpore.name: Balloon Spore
BalloonSpore.description: A fluffy giant spore. It's non-toxic but also not very useful.

CavelingDoll.name: Caveling Doll
CavelingDoll.description: A handmade doll found in a grave. It must once have belonged to a child...

SmallCavelingSkull.name: Small Caveling Skull
SmallCavelingSkull.description: A caveling skull, smaller than usual. It hints at a tragic story.

GoldenFeather.name: Golden Feather
GoldenFeather.description: It's big and shiny, a must have for collectors.

MechanicalArm.name: Mechanical Arm
MechanicalArm.description: An overgrown piece of ancient technology. The joints are stiff but it must have performed remarkable tasks in the past.

DryButterfly.name: Dry Butterfly
DryButterfly.description: A dead insect void of any moisture. It is nice to look at but needs to be handled with care.

PreciousUrn.name: Precious Urn
PreciousUrn.description: A pretty decorative without any cracks and blemishes but its original contents are long gone.

AmberChunk.name: Amber Chunk
AmberChunk.description: Solid remains of an ancient forest. The light it reflects is warm and golden.

PetrifiedCoral.name: Petrified Coral
PetrifiedCoral.description: A gray and porous piece of a giant ecosystem. The ocean it belonged to seems long gone.

MoldDew.name: Mold Dew
MoldDew.description: Golden-colored dew that emanated from mold spores, maybe someone can find a use for it.

FungalBone.name: Fungal Bone
FungalBone.description: Rotten with mold down to the marrow, its owner must have suffered greatly.

MildewLeaf.name: Mildew Leaf
MildewLeaf.description: A leaf with white mold spots on it, apart from that it looks unscathed.

ChippedPlate.name: Chipped Plate
ChippedPlate.description: An old stone plate. What kind of food has been served on it?

StoneCap.name: Stone Cap
StoneCap.description: Rock-hard mushrooms attached to a stone slate. They look edible but are actually fossilized.

GiantMite.name: Giant Mite
GiantMite.description: A motionless crimson critter. It just sits there...watching...

RustySpoon.name: Rusty Spoon
RustySpoon.description: An old, corroded eating utensil. Almost every culture has invented it.

GreenKelp.name: Green Kelp
GreenKelp.description: A green lump of marine plants.

GoldenStarfish.name: Golden Starfish
GoldenStarfish.description: A razorsharp ocean critter polished clean by currents.

AmberFishEgg.name: Amber Fish Egg
AmberFishEgg.description: A perfectly preserved fish egg encapsulated in amber. How those two combined is a mystery.

SoftSponge.name: Soft Sponge
SoftSponge.description: A soft, squishy sponge. Time to take a bath!

AdderStone.name: Adder Stone
AdderStone.description: A porous smooth stone, some believe it wards off evil spirits.

CavelingPerfume.name: Caveling Perfume
CavelingPerfume.description: A blue fragrance bottle. It is tightly sealed but emits a heavenly scent.

EnhydroCrystal.name: Enhydro Crystal
EnhydroCrystal.description: Ancient water is encapsulated in this beautiful crystal. It's been in there for millions of years.

MucusAmoeba.name: Mucus Amoeba
MucusAmoeba.description: A slimy giant amoeba, it seems to be looking at you.

ParasiteFossil.name: Parasite Fossil
ParasiteFossil.description: The petrified remains of an ancient parasite, it is uncertain if it's really dead.

GoldenCocoon.name: Golden Cocoon
GoldenCocoon.description: A gold-plated chrysalis, this doesn't seem to be its final form.

GrubPearl.name: Grub Pearl
GrubPearl.description: Is it a grub-shaped pearl or a pearl-like grub?

GiantGerm.name: Giant Germ
GiantGerm.description: A big bacterium wiggling around in your hand, fascinating and gross at the same time.

MoldShell.name: Mold Shell
MoldShell.description: The fuzzy, pale housing of a critter that has moved on.

CeremonialFlute.name: Ceremonial Flute
CeremonialFlute.description: An ancient, precious instrument but it is clogged.

DataSlate.name: Data Slate
DataSlate.description: A stone disc with peculiar engravings, it must contain mysterious records.

LostPaddle.name: Lost Paddle
LostPaddle.description: Somewhere, someone must have paddled in circles.

FeatherFishScale.name: Feather Fish Scale
FeatherFishScale.description: Scale of the Feather Fish, it is sturdy but as light as a feather.

CavelingMedal.name: Caveling Medal
CavelingMedal.description: A minted medallion with a face relief. Perhaps it was once awarded to an extraordinary individual?

RainbowKelp.name: Rainbow Kelp
RainbowKelp.description: A super rare mutation of common kelp, showing off a variety of colors.

BubblePearl.name: Bubble Pearl
BubblePearl.description: A beautiful, iridescent pearl. It seems to be hollow.

BlackBubblePearl.name: Black Bubble Pearl
BlackBubblePearl.description: A black variant of the bubble pearl, from certain angles it appears golden.

SealedBeverage.name: Sealed Beverage
SealedBeverage.description: An unknown liquid slushes inside when shaken. Is there an ancient corkscrew around?

SharkTooth.name: Shark Tooth
SharkTooth.description: It's as big as the palm of a hand, meeting with a row of those will end up fatal.

ForkedCoral.name: Forked Coral
ForkedCoral.description: A trident-shaped coral, not very valuable but nice to look at.

PetrifiedTrilobite.name: Petrified Trilobite
PetrifiedTrilobite.description: The fossil of a long gone critter species. They are ancestors of a big variety of lifeforms.

RustyFishingHook.name: Rusty Fishing Hook
RustyFishingHook.description: Rusted to the core and unusable. That fish was too big to handle, pal.

FishFossil.name: Fish Fossil
FishFossil.description: The imprint of an ancient fish on a rock slate.

FizzyCrystal.name: Fizzy Crystal
FizzyCrystal.description: A bubbly stone that is as clear as water. It weighs almost nothing.

GreyKelp.name: Gray Kelp
GreyKelp.description: A gray lump of marine plants.

YellowKelp.name: Yellow Kelp
YellowKelp.description: A yellow lump of marine plants.

PaleKelp.name: Pale Kelp
PaleKelp.description: A pale lump of marine plants.

RedKelp.name: Red Kelp
RedKelp.description: A red lump of marine plants.

EarlyHumanSkull.name: Early Human Skull
EarlyHumanSkull.description: Remains of a human that lived about 200.000 years ago. Has mankind found these caves before?

GoldenCavelingMask.name: Golden Caveling Mask
GoldenCavelingMask.description: An intricate mask with a stern expression, it was probably used in a ritual or by someone of high ranks.

AncientGemPlate.name: Ancient Gem Plate
AncientGemPlate.description: This shimmering plate has intricate engravings, it looks like a key to something.

AntiqueBoardGame.name: Antique Board Game
AntiqueBoardGame.description: An ancient game for two players, there is no rulebook but apparently it was about shifting blocks around.

MusicBowl.name: Music Bowl
MusicBowl.description: A precious bowl holding a golden cylinder that once seemed to have played a melancholic melody. But it stopped working.

SeismicClock.name: Seismic Clock
SeismicClock.description: This broken device looks like it was able to predict earthquakes.

OldJournal.name: Old Journal
OldJournal.description: A leather-bound book with crumbly pages. It is written in familiar letters but a language you don't know.

ParsecPalsDolls.name: Mysterious Doll Set
ParsecPalsDolls.description: A pair of green dolls wearing clothes, sitting together they look like great pals.

RitualGoblet.name: Ritual Goblet
RitualGoblet.description: An ancient chalice made from stone and gems. Its insides are layered with dark red residue.

OracleCardCore.name: Oracle Card "Entity"
OracleCardCore.description: A bent card with golden borders and an image of the core. Looks like it's part of a set.

GlurchTrophy.name: Glurch Figurine
GlurchTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Glurch the Abominous Mass.

IvyTrophy.name: Ivy Figurine
IvyTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Ivy the Poisonous Mass.

GhormTrophy.name: Ghorm Figurine
GhormTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Ghorm the Devourer.

HivemotherTrophy.name: Hive Mother Figurine
HivemotherTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the Hive Mother.

SlimeTrophy.name: Slime Figurine
SlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a common Orange Slime.

PurpleSlimeTrophy.name: Purple Slime Figurine
PurpleSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a poisonous Purple Slime.

RedSlimeTrophy.name: Red Slime Figurine
RedSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of an aggressive Red Slime.

AcidLarvaTrophy.name: Acid Larva Figurine
AcidLarvaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of an Acid Larva.

LarvaTrophy.name: Larva Figurine
LarvaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Larva.

BigLarvaTrophy.name: Big Larva Figurine
BigLarvaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Big Larva.

HiveLarvaTrophy.name: Hive Larva Figurine
HiveLarvaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Hive Larva.

HiveBigLarvaTrophy.name: Big Hive Larva Figurine
HiveBigLarvaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Big Hive Larva.

CavelingTrophy.name: Caveling Figurine
CavelingTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling.

CavelingFarmerTrophy.name: Caveling Gardener Figurine
CavelingFarmerTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Gardener.

CavelingHunterTrophy.name: Caveling Hunter Figurine
CavelingHunterTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Hunter.

CavelingShamanTrophy.name: Caveling Shaman Figurine
CavelingShamanTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Shaman.

CavelingInfectedTrophy.name: Infected Caveling Figurine
CavelingInfectedTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Infected Caveling.

CavelingBruteTrophy.name: Caveling Brute Figurine
CavelingBruteTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Brute.

AzeosTrophy.name: Azeos Figurine
AzeosTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Azeos the Sky Titan.

MalugazTrophy.name: Malugaz Figurine
MalugazTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Malugaz the Corrupted.

TentacleTrophy.name: Tentacle Figurine
TentacleTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Tentacle.

MoldTentacleTrophy.name: Mold Tentacle Figurine
MoldTentacleTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Mold Tentacle.

SnarePlantTrophy.name: Snare Plant Figurine
SnarePlantTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Snare Plant.

BlueSlimeTrophy.name: Blue Slime Figurine
BlueSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a slippery Blue Slime.

OracleCardGem.name: Oracle Card "Aura"
OracleCardGem.description: A ripped card with golden borders and an image of an ancient gemstone. Looks like it's part of a set.

OracleCardFlower.name: Oracle Card "Brilliance"
OracleCardFlower.description: A charred card with golden borders and an image of a Glow Tulip. Looks like it's part of a set.

EasterAzeosTrophy.name: Awakened Azeos Figurine
EasterAzeosTrophy.description: A unique lifelike representation of the Awakened Azeos.

ScreenDevice.name: Screen Device
ScreenDevice.description: A small device made from blue glass, perfectly fitting into your hand. It's touch sensitive and scrolls through images and glyphs.

CavelingEffigy.name: Caveling Effigy
CavelingEffigy.description: A small depiction of a caveling, it's hollow and must have been used for storing small goods.

CrystalSphere.name: Crystal Sphere
CrystalSphere.description: A small orb made from deep-blue glass. Its purpose is unknown.

LuxuriousHandmirror.name: Luxurious Handmirror
LuxuriousHandmirror.description: A hand-held mirror in great condition. Clearly someone had a sense of beauty.

ProcessorChip.name: Processor Chip
ProcessorChip.description: This intricate, golden chip seems technically very advanced and must have computed complex calculations.

TimelessHourglass.name: Timeless Hourglass
TimelessHourglass.description: An intact hourglass, filled with blue sand. It is not clear what period of time it measures, as the sand seems to fall incredibly slowly.

PlayingDice.name: Playing Dice
PlayingDice.description: A playing dice with unique symbols on each face. It's probably been used in sets and for multiple different games.

GoldenWhistle.name: Golden Whistle
GoldenWhistle.description: A small golden whistle with unknown purpose. The sounds it emits is almost unnoticable.

BentFork.name: Bent Fork
BentFork.description: A simple fork that has seen too much use.

CavelingCup.name: Caveling Cup
CavelingCup.description: This small drinking cup must have held many different beverages. There is still a faint smell of something sweet.

OracleCardScholar.name: Oracle Card "Wisdom"
OracleCardScholar.description: A soaked card with golden borders and an image of a caveling scholar. Looks like it's part of a set.

OracleCardCity.name: Oracle Card "Metropolis"
OracleCardCity.description: A card in mint condition with golden borders and an image of an ancient city. Looks like it's part of a set.

OracleCardLeader.name: Oracle Card "Inspiration"
OracleCardLeader.description: Half of a card with golden borders and an image of a golden mask. Looks like it's part of a set.

CoreTrophy.name: Core Figurine
CoreTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the core.

MorphaTrophy.name: Morpha Figurine
MorphaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Morpha, the Aquatic Mass.

CocoonTrophy.name: Cocoon Figurine
CocoonTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a cocoon.

OmorothTrophy.name: Omoroth Figurine
OmorothTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Omoroth, the Sea Titan.

CrabTrophy.name: Bubble Crab Figurine
CrabTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a bubble crab.

GolemTrophy.name: Core Sentry Figurine
GolemTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a core sentry.

ScholarTrophy.name: Caveling Scholar Figurine
ScholarTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a caveling scholar.

GiantSquidEye.name: Giant Squid Eye
GiantSquidEye.description: A sensory organ of a big sea creature. It probably was lost in a fight to death with something even bigger.

GoldenNeedle.name: Golden Needle
GoldenNeedle.description: This little treasure was used to hold the robe of a caveling scholar in place.

PolishedShell.name: Polished Shell
PolishedShell.description: A mirror-like smooth shell that was ground down by currents and swirling sand from the sea ground.

OpabiniaFossil.name: Opabinia Fossil
OpabiniaFossil.description: The petrified body of an prehistoric sea critter. They were one of the first apex predators to appear in the ancient oceans of earth.

BlueKelp.name: Blue Kelp
BlueKelp.description: A blue lump of marine plants.

MushroomEnemyTrophy.name: Shrooman Figurine
MushroomEnemyTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a shrooman.

KingSlimeTrophy.name: King Slime Figurine
KingSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the King Slime.

OracleCardAzeos.name: Oracle Card "Radiance"
OracleCardAzeos.description: A scratched card with golden borders and an image of the sky titan. Looks like it's part of a set.

OracleCardOmoroth.name: Oracle Card "Temperance"
OracleCardOmoroth.description: A faded card with golden borders and an image of the sea titan. Looks like it's part of a set.

OracleCardRaAkar.name: Oracle Card "Endurance"
OracleCardRaAkar.description: A crumbling card with golden borders and an image of the sand titan. Looks like it's part of a set.

BlueGlassShard.name: Blue Glass Shard
BlueGlassShard.description: A piece of deep blue glass, it appears to be a fusion of molten sand and ancient gemstones.

CharredCavelingSkull.name: Charred Caveling Skull
CharredCavelingSkull.description: A small skull burnt dark to the marrow. Exposure to intense heat for a long time causes something like this to happen.

CavelingSandal.name: Caveling Sandal
CavelingSandal.description: This simple footwear is perfect as a protection against hot desert sand. Unfortunately it's too small to be worn by a human.

WorkerHandcuff.name: Worker Handcuff
WorkerHandcuff.description: Cast from thick metal this tool seemed to be attached to a chain. Has it been used to keep the unlawful from running away?

CrystalSpearhead.name: Crystal Spearhead
CrystalSpearhead.description: The leftovers of a crude prehistoric weapon made with an ancient gemstone. It may have helped early humans to hunt more effectively.

MoltenButterflyWing.name: Melting Lava Wing
MoltenButterflyWing.description: The wing of a lava butterfly, swinging it causes sparks to fly off in all directions.

PlumeBall.name: Plume Ball
PlumeBall.description: A bundle of leaves that grows on plume trees.

PickaxeHead.name: Pickaxe Head
PickaxeHead.description: The top part of an iron pickaxe that is partially molten. It must have been broken while working under extreme conditions.

DesertDiamond.name: Desert Diamond
DesertDiamond.description: A very rare crystal sparkling with a beautiful white light.

BlackDesertDiamond.name: Black Desert Diamond
BlackDesertDiamond.description: The black variant of a desert diamond that is highly sought after by miners. It seems to invert reflected light and cast it back as shadows.

BagOfMarbles.name: Bag of Marbles
BagOfMarbles.description: A small bag holding multiple colored marbles made from glass and cheap gemstones. They have probably been used for child's games.

AncientGoldenCoin.name: Ancient Golden Coin
AncientGoldenCoin.description: This coin cast in gold seems to be a much older currency than the common ancient coins. It's also worth a whole lot more.

IncenseBowl.name: Incense Bowl
IncenseBowl.description: A porcelain bowl with blue details on the edge and dark residue in its center. The smell that still lingers around it eases the senses.

AncientMakeupSet.name: Ancient Makeup Set
AncientMakeupSet.description: A small wooden box containing all kinds of brushes, pastes and powders that have been used for makeup.

CavelingProphetMask.name: Caveling Prophet Mask
CavelingProphetMask.description: This intricate mask seems to have been worn by an important spiritual figure.

FrozenFlame.name: Frozen Flame
FrozenFlame.description: A gemstone that is shaped like crystalline fire.

IgneousTrophy.name: Igneous Figurine
IgneousTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Igneous, the Molten Mass.

RaAkarTrophy.name: Ra-Akar Figurine
RaAkarTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Ra-Akar, the Sand Titan.

BombScarabTrophy.name: Bomb Scarab Figurine
BombScarabTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Bomb Scarab.

LavaButterflyTrophy.name: Lava Butterfly Figurine
LavaButterflyTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Lava Butterfly

CavelingAssassinTrophy.name: Caveling Assassin Figurine
CavelingAssassinTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Assassin

LavaSlimeTrophy.name: Lava Slime Figurine
LavaSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Lava Slime.

BrokenGourd.name: Broken Gourd
BrokenGourd.description: A broken container made from clay. It was used to carry rations of water across the desert.

KingfishScale.name: Kingfish Scale
KingfishScale.description: This beautiful scale seems to belong to a truly extraordinary fish.

BrokenToyShip.name: Broken Toy Ship
BrokenToyShip.description: A leaking wooden ship that is missing its sail.

FleshKelp.name: Flesh Kelp
FleshKelp.description: A flesh-colored lump of marine plants.

AncientFishingHook.name: Ancient Fishing Hook
AncientFishingHook.description: A very old design for a fishing hook that is not used anymore.

FusionAlloy.name: Fusion Alloy
FusionAlloy.description: Looks like a failed experiment to create a new type of alloy. It is too hard to be usable in any way.

StarlightShards.name: Starlight Shards
StarlightShards.description: A collection of sparkling colorful crystals. If they grew natural or not remains a mystery.

DarkBlueKelp.name: Dark Blue Kelp
DarkBlueKelp.description: A dark blue lump of marine plants.

WhiteWhistle.name: White Whistle
WhiteWhistle.description: A rare artifact made from precious, white stone. It doesn't produce a sound when you try to use it.

HiveHalloweenBossTrophy.name: Haunted Hive Mother Figurine
HiveHalloweenBossTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the Haunted Hive Mother.

FrankensteinCavelingBruteTrophy.name: Frankenbrute Figurine
FrankensteinCavelingBruteTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Frankenbrute.

PumpkinHeadCavelingShamanTrophy.name: Pumpking Caveling Figurine
PumpkinHeadCavelingShamanTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Pumpking Caveling.

GhostBlanketCavelingTrophy.name: Spookaveling Figurine
GhostBlanketCavelingTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Spookaveling.

BigLarvaVampireTrophy.name: Big Dracularva Figurine
BigLarvaVampireTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Big Dracularva.

CavelingSkirmisherTrophy.name: Caveling Skirmisher Figurine
CavelingSkirmisherTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Skirmisher.

CavelingSpearmanTrophy.name: Caveling Spearman Figurine
CavelingSpearmanTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Spearman.

CrystalStar.name: Crystal Star
CrystalStar.description: A golden-colored glass star for decorating the base in a festive fashion. Better not drop it.

SnowGlobe.name: Snow Globe
SnowGlobe.description: This little globe has the core as its center and starts a snowfall when shaken.

SentryNutcracker.name: Sentry Nutcracker
SentryNutcracker.description: A little nutcracker shaped after a core sentry in festive garment. Sadly there are no nuts around to be cracked.

WinterBell.name: Winter Bell
WinterBell.description: This golden and white bell produces a fine ringing sound, it's faint and reminds one of falling snow.

ChristmasShamanTrophy.name: Starwand Shaman Figurine
ChristmasShamanTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Starwand Shaman.

ChristmasSlimeTrophy.name: Snowhead Slime Figurine
ChristmasSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Snowhead Slime.

ChristmasSpikedSlimeTrophy.name: Carrot Slime Figurine
ChristmasSpikedSlimeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Carrot Slime.

ChristmasBruteTrophy.name: Bakery Brute Figurine
ChristmasBruteTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Bakery Brute.

ChristmasCavelingTrophy.name: Gingerbreadling Figurine
ChristmasCavelingTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Gingerbreadling.

ChristmasShroomanTrophy.name: Santa Shrooman Figurine
ChristmasShroomanTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Santa Shrooman.

LumpOfCoal.name: Lump of Coal
LumpOfCoal.description: A dusty piece of coal that leaves your hands black and your conscience tainted. Have you perhaps been naughty?

PinkRoseBouquet.name: Pink Rose Bouquet
PinkRoseBouquet.description: This beautiful bouquet made from pink roses will elevate the look of every room. Give it to someone you like dearly.

WhiteRoseBouquet.name: White Rose Bouquet
WhiteRoseBouquet.description: This beautiful bouquet made from white roses will elevate the look of every room. Give it to someone you like dearly.

GoldenRoseBouquet.name: Golden Rose Bouquet
GoldenRoseBouquet.description: This beautiful bouquet made from golden roses will elevate the look of every room. Give it to someone you like dearly.

EnchantedRose.name: Enchanted Rose
EnchantedRose.description: To love another and earn their love in return.

RoseWater.name: Rose Water
RoseWater.description: A vial containing water and rose extract, said to make ones skin silky smooth and hair shiny.

HeartOfGold.name: Heart of Gold
HeartOfGold.description: Rewarded to those who truly look out for others and help whenever they can.

BlueGlassKalimba.name: Blue Glass Kalimba
BlueGlassKalimba.description: A delicate instrument that has multiple fractures across its surface, rendering it unusable. There is a signature reading "Woopsiee", that has been carved into the glass.

OffspringCapsule.name: Offspring Capsule
OffspringCapsule.description: A glass container containing an embryo suspended in nutritious liquid. It's blue with pointy ears but doesn't seem to be a caveling.

HomeworldReminiscence.name: Homeworld Reminiscence
HomeworldReminiscence.description: The replica of a blue, glistening planet, orbited by what seems to be three suns. Is this a model of a solar system?

CatalystGemstone.name: Catalyst Gemstone
CatalystGemstone.description: It looks like an Ancient Gemstone but seems to be extremely dense with energy. Has it been used to grow the Shimmering Frontier?

ChemicalRation.name: Chemical Ration
ChemicalRation.description: This box contains a strange, synthetic food source that doesn't appear safe for human consumption.

DeepspaceLog.name: Deepspace Log
DeepspaceLog.description: A thin glass tablet that displays a map of unfamiliar star constellations.

TriopsFossil.name: Triops Fossil
TriopsFossil.description: The petrified remains of a species that still exists to this day, even after 220 million years.

SuspendedButterfly.name: Suspended Butterfly
SuspendedButterfly.description: A fragile butterfly that has been completely corrupted by crystals.

CrystalBone.name: Crystal Bone
CrystalBone.description: All that's left of a creature that had the misfortune to stumble upon the Shimmering Frontier.

AgarthaReport.name: Agartha Report
AgarthaReport.description: A leatherbound book written in unsteady human language. It appears that the author believed to have found the mythological center of the earth, before succumbing to illness.

SparkleOpal.name: Sparkle Opal
SparkleOpal.description: A magnificent gemstone that glitters in pastel rainbow colors.

AtlantianWormTrophy.name: Atlantean Worm Figurine
AtlantianWormTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the Atlantean Worm.

MimiteTrophy.name: Mimite Figurine
MimiteTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Mimite.

OrbitalTurretTrophy.name: Orbital Turret Figurine
OrbitalTurretTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of an Orbital Turret.

NilipedeTrophy.name: Nilipede Figurine
NilipedeTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Nilipede.

ClayWormTrophy.name: Clay Burrower Figurine
ClayWormTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Clay Burrower.

HydraBossNatureTrophy.name: Druidra Figurine
HydraBossNatureTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Druidra the Wild Titan.

HydraBossDesertTrophy.name: Pyrdra Figurine
HydraBossDesertTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Pyrdra the Fire Titan.

HydraBossSeaTrophy.name: Crydra Figurine
HydraBossSeaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Crydra the Ice Titan.

CoreCommanderTrophy.name: Core Commander Figurine
CoreCommanderTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the Core Commander.

UnleashedCoreCommanderTrophy.name: Unleashed Core Commander Figurine
UnleashedCoreCommanderTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of the Unleashed Core Commander.

ColossalAmoebaTrophy.name: Colossal Amoeba Figurine
ColossalAmoebaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Colossal Amoeba.

SulfurWormTrophy.name: Sulfur Worm Figurine
SulfurWormTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Sulfur Worm.

CavelingMummyTrophy.name: Caveling Mummy Figurine
CavelingMummyTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Mummy.

ShroomanBruteTrophy.name: Shrooman Brute Figurine
ShroomanBruteTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Shrooman Brute.

GoldenBombScarabTrophy.name: Gold Scarab Figurine
GoldenBombScarabTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Gold Scarab.

CicadaNymphTrophy.name: Cicada Nymph Figurine
CicadaNymphTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Cicada Nymph.

CicadaNatureTrophy.name: Floracada Figurine
CicadaNatureTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Floracada.

GiantCicadaBossTrophy.name: Nimruza Figurine
GiantCicadaBossTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands.

VoidLarvaTrophy.name: Void Larva Figurine
VoidLarvaTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Void Larva.

VoidLarvaCocoonTrophy.name: Void Larva Cocoon Figurine
VoidLarvaCocoonTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Void Larva Cocoon.

RobotMinerTrophy.name: Geobot Miner Figurine
RobotMinerTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Geobot Miner.

RobotPatrollerTrophy.name: Geobot Patroller Figurine
RobotPatrollerTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Geobot Patroller.

RobotSwarmerTrophy.name: Geobot Scourer Figurine
RobotSwarmerTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Geobot Scourer.

VoidCavelingMinerTrophy.name: Void Caveling Figurine
VoidCavelingMinerTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Void Caveling.

VoidCavelingShamanTrophy.name: Void Caveling Shaman Figurine
VoidCavelingShamanTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Void Caveling Shaman.

VoidCavelingBruteTrophy.name: Void Caveling Brute Figurine
VoidCavelingBruteTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of a Void Caveling Brute.

HydraBossVoidTrophy.name: Oblidra Figurine
HydraBossVoidTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of Oblidra the Void Lord.

Mushroom.name: Mushroom
Mushroom.description: A small cave mushroom, perfect for a snack on the go.

GiantMushroom.name: Giant Mushroom (old)
GiantMushroom.description: The king of all mushrooms. Growing in perfect conditions made it unusually large.

GiantMushroom2.name: Giant Mushroom
GiantMushroom2.description: The king of all mushrooms. Growing in perfect conditions made it unusually large.

AmberLarva2.name: Amber Larva
AmberLarva2.description: Grub encapsulated in amber, an extremely rare ingredient.

StoneCavelingMoss.name: Stone Moss
StoneCavelingMoss.description: Ground plants found in the Forgotten Ruins. They grow tiny berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

NatureCavelingMoss.name: Lush Moss
NatureCavelingMoss.description: Ground plants found in Azeos' Wilderness. They grow tiny berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

CityCavelingMoss.name: Urban Moss
CityCavelingMoss.description: Ground plants found in the Forlorn Metropolis. They grow tiny berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

FungalGrowth.name: Fungal Soil
FungalGrowth.description: Groundcover interspersed with mycelium. Over time mushrooms and shroomen will grow on it.

DesertCavelingMoss.name: Valley Moss
DesertCavelingMoss.description: Ground plants found in the Desert of Beginnings. They grow fragrant flowers that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

ClayCavelingMoss.name: Clay Moss
ClayCavelingMoss.description: Ground plants found in the Clay Caves. They grow aromatic berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

Chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
Chrysalis.description: Icky groundcover that feels strange to walk across. Larvas will infest chrysalis-covered areas over time.

GroundSlime.name: Ground Slime
GroundSlime.description: Sticky material that slows down careless adventurers. Slime blobs will start to coagulate from slime covered surfaces over time.

GroundAcidSlime.name: Ground Acid Slime
GroundAcidSlime.description: Sticky material that slowly dissolves everything that touches it.

GroundPoisonSlime.name: Ground Poison Slime
GroundPoisonSlime.description: Sticky material that builds up toxin in the body.

GroundSlipperySlime.name: Ground Slippery Slime
GroundSlipperySlime.description: Slick material that makes it difficult to get a steady footing.

GroundLavaSlime.name: Ground Magma Slime
GroundLavaSlime.description: Sticky material mixed with magma that burns careless explorers.

CrystalCrust.name: Crystal Crust
CrystalCrust.description: A shimmering surface that attracts lifeforms found in crystalline environments.

GroundOilSlime.name: Ground Oil
GroundOilSlime.description: Sticky material that slows down and drenches careless adventurers in fire-hazardous oil.

AncientDestructible.name: Ancient Crate
AncientDestructible.description: A mysteriously glowing container holding ancient goods.

RuinsPiece1.name: Ruins Arc
RuinsPiece1.description: A giant stone slate that seemingly was once part of the ceiling. Tremors must have brought it down.

RuinsPiece2.name: Ruins Gate
RuinsPiece2.description: A toppled entrance made from carved stone and ancient gemstones. It seems to have been part of a sprawling city.

RuinsPiece3.name: Ruins Tile
RuinsPiece3.description: This thick stone tile features a pattern that looks like the core. It has been dislodged from the ground.

RuinsPiece4.name: Ruins Pillars
RuinsPiece4.description: Toppled over stone pillars that once supported a very high ceiling. When they fell, they must have caused a lot of destruction.

PottedLandKelp.name: Potted Land Algae
PottedLandKelp.description: A decorative version of the common Land Algae, planted in a driftwood pot.

PottedFlowerTree.name: Potted Bloom Tree
PottedFlowerTree.description: A potted shrub on which beautiful flowers grow. It seems to only exist in this form.

PottedPlumeTree.name: Potted Plume Tree
PottedPlumeTree.description: A bonsai-sized offshoot of the common plume tree, planted in an ancient pot.

PottedCherryTree.name: Potted Cherry Tree
PottedCherryTree.description: A bonsai-sized offshoot of the common cherry tree, planted in a decorative vase.

PottedLushTree.name: Potted Lush Tree
PottedLushTree.description: A shrub of the common Lush Tree, planted in a makeshift stone pot.

PottedPuffSticks.name: Potted Mold Pompom
PottedPuffSticks.description: An oversized, puffy flower that has been infested with mold.

PottedLushBush.name: Potted Abyss Tree
PottedLushBush.description: A tree that grows in the chasms of Azeos Wilderness, planted in a clay pot.

PottedMagmaTulip.name: Potted Magma Tulip
PottedMagmaTulip.description: A rare, decorative strain of a Glow Tulip that can withstand tremendous heat.

PottedGlowberryTree.name: Potted Moonbell Tree
PottedGlowberryTree.description: A potted shrub on which glowing flowers grow. It seems to only exist in this form.

PottedGoldenOrbBush.name: Potted Meadow Tree
PottedGoldenOrbBush.description: A bonsai-sized offshoot of the common meadow tree, planted in a wooden pot.

PottedLucentTree.name: Potted Lucent Oak
PottedLucentTree.description: A shrub of the magnificient Lucent Oak, growing from a naturally formed crystal pot.

PottedAlienFlower.name: Potted Alien Flower
PottedAlienFlower.description: It is not an actual flower but a hologram of one. Is it proof of a dying world where nothing grew anymore?

ColossCicada.name: Colossal Cicada Husk
ColossCicada.description: The cast-off husk of a giant insect that lives dormant in the ground for centuries. When it emerges to take on its final form, heavy earthquakes occur.

AmberLarva.name: Amber Larva (old)
AmberLarva.description: Grub encapsulated in amber, an extremely rare ingredient.

HiveDestructible.name: Hive Growth
HiveDestructible.description: A vein-like growth that reveals loot when popped open.

Stalagmite.name: Stalagmite
Stalagmite.description: A stone pillar grown over thousands of years through dripping water.

WoodenDestructible.name: Wooden Crate
WoodenDestructible.description: A wooden box used by someone to store random goods.

NatureDestructible.name: Flower Vessel
NatureDestructible.description: A yellow plant containing organic loot.

WaterKelp.name: Sun Kelp
WaterKelp.description: A large seaweed that lives off of the light cast down into the wilderness.

WaterLily.name: Azeos Lily
WaterLily.description: A floating plant that is part of a rich aquatic ecosystem.

AncientFeather.name: Ancient Feather
AncientFeather.description: An unusual feather left by something big.

Bush.name: Bush
Bush.description: A stubby patch of grass to use as a decorative.

TallGrass.name: Tall Grass
TallGrass.description: A large patch of tall grass to use as a decorative.

GraveTree.name: Lush Tree
GraveTree.description: This verdant tree seems to have spent many years growing in an ancient forest. Plant it back into the ground to decorate your home.

AbandonedCampTent.name: Camp Tent
AbandonedCampTent.description: An abandoned makeshift tent, who would have lived here?

AbandonedCampMatress.name: Camp Matress
AbandonedCampMatress.description: The resting place of a former adventurer?

MoldDestructible.name: Mold Vessel
MoldDestructible.description: A hollow, fuzzy fungus. Breaking it open may yield some useful goods.

NatureWoodenDestructible.name: Overgrown Wooden Crate
NatureWoodenDestructible.description: A box that has been partially reclaimed by nature. It contains useful goods.

BigJungleTree.name: Paradise Tree
BigJungleTree.description: A giant jungle tree that seems to have grown from the essence of life itself. A must have decoration.

CicadaBurrow.name: Cicada Burrow
CicadaBurrow.description: A formidable tunneler dug this hollow.

CavelingFloorTile.name: Caveling Floor Tile
CavelingFloorTile.description: A crumbly stone slab with simple patterns embedded in it.

BrokenStonePillar.name: Broken Stone Pillar
BrokenStonePillar.description: Unstable pillar for decoration, probably thousands of years old.

CavelingPot.name: Caveling Pot
CavelingPot.description: An urn made from stone filled with the belongings of cavelings.

CavelingTable.name: Caveling Table
CavelingTable.description: A crude, blocky piece of furniture, many meals must have been shared on it.

CavelingToilet.name: Caveling Toilet
CavelingToilet.description: Between mining there must be time for serious business.

WaterWell.name: Water Well
WaterWell.description: An ancient stone well to take water from.

CavelingFloorTileDark.name: Dark Caveling Floor Tile
CavelingFloorTileDark.description: A dark version of the ancient floor tiles, it looks much older.

CavelingThrone.name: Caveling Throne
CavelingThrone.description: This unusual seat is proof of an empire fallen to ruin.

LarvaBBQ.name: Roast Firepit
LarvaBBQ.description: Part fireplace, part barbecue. It is a great place to huddle together and enjoy some burned pieces of larva meat.

LarvaSkewer.name: Larva Skewer
LarvaSkewer.description: A pretty cruel way of stacking up meat for later use.

LarvaskinTent.name: Larvaskin Tent
LarvaskinTent.description: This simple type of housing must have used many skins of larva. There are patches of other creatures thrown in too.

SpearRack.name: Spear Rack
SpearRack.description: A crudely-made rack that is used by cavelings to have their spears at the ready.

Kiln1.name: Broken Clay Kiln
Kiln1.description: Having seen many years of use this old kiln is beyond repair.

Kiln2.name: Clay Firing Bucket
Kiln2.description: A simple gadget that was used to burn clay and make it harder.

LarvaskinRug.name: Larvaskin Rug
LarvaskinRug.description: This gross rug doubles down as a trophy for the hunted larva that provided their skin.

LarvaskinRugRed.name: Hive Larvaskin Rug
LarvaskinRugRed.description: This gross rug doubles down as a trophy for the hunted hive larva that provided their skin.

LeatherFrameSmall.name: Small Clamping Frame
LeatherFrameSmall.description: This small wooden frame made use of even the tiniest larva to turn its skin into leather.

LeatherFrame.name: Clamping Frame
LeatherFrame.description: This wooden frame has been used to stretch larva skin and manufacture it into leather.

ClayPot.name: Clay Pot
ClayPot.description: A crude container that's already almost broken. Smash it to relieve it of its contents.

MoldTree.name: Mold Tree
MoldTree.description: A once green tree that is thoroughly infected with mold.

MoldWell.name: Mold Well
MoldWell.description: You surely don't want to water your plants with its contents.

MoldPillar.name: Mold Pillar
MoldPillar.description: An ancient pillar featuring the core, it is overgrown by mold.

MoldCicada.name: Mold Cicada (Sickle)
MoldCicada.description: A colossal cicada that died before it could cast off its hull. It looks like it got infected with an aggressive mold that caused it to run rampant.

MoldCicadaWithoutSickle.name: Mold Cicada
MoldCicadaWithoutSickle.description: A colossal cicada that died before it could cast off its hull. It looks like it got infected with an aggressive mold that caused it to run rampant.

ExcavationMoss.name: Rust Pile
ExcavationMoss.description: Debris of mechanical junk found in the Breaker's Reach. It attracts Geobots of the corresponding area.

ExcavationVoidMoss.name: Muddled Moss
ExcavationVoidMoss.description: Groundcover interspersed with purplish mycelium. Over time it grows glowing mushrooms, and attracts beings from the void.

GlowingMushroom.name: Glowing Mushroom
GlowingMushroom.description: A bitter, pungent mushroom that brightens up murky caves.

ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationPatroller.name: Broken Geobot Patroller
ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationPatroller.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationCharger.name: Broken Geobot Charger
ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationCharger.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationCharger2.name: Decrepit Geobot Charger
ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationCharger2.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationSwarmer.name: Broken Geobot Swarmer
ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationSwarmer.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationSwarmer2.name: Decrepit Geobot Swarmer
ExcavationBrokenRobotDecorationSwarmer2.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

JellyfishDestructable.name: Beached Jelly
JellyfishDestructable.description: A gelatinous creature containing goods from the sea.

GlowingCoral.name: Lumen Coral
GlowingCoral.description: A branching type of coral that gets its energy through the glowing waters of the Sunken Sea.

LandKelp.name: Land Algae
LandKelp.description: A type of algae that can grow outside of water.

TallLandKelp.name: Tall Land Algae
TallLandKelp.description: A large type of algae that can grow outside of water.

KelpTree.name: Kelp Tree
KelpTree.description: It's technically not a tree but a giant kelp with a double-helix coral as a trunk.

FishingNetRack.name: Fishing Net Rack
FishingNetRack.description: A loose net thrown across some stakes to dry in the air.

DriftwoodTable.name: Driftwood Table
DriftwoodTable.description: Someone made this from materials floating in the water.

DriftwoodStool.name: Driftwood Stool
DriftwoodStool.description: A simple stool made with beach materials.

WoodenSign1.name: Wooden Sign "Core"
WoodenSign1.description: Driftwood with patterns and carvings showing the Core.

WoodenSign2.name: Wooden Sign "Tulip"
WoodenSign2.description: Driftwood with patterns and carvings showing a Glow Tulip.

RuinsGate.name: Metropolis Gate
RuinsGate.description: An intact stone gate found at the forlorn metropolis. It stands tall and must have dazzled visitors with the giant ancient gemstone in its center.

RuinsCoreRelief.name: Core Relief Tile
RuinsCoreRelief.description: A giant, gold-rimmed stone tile, depicting a rendition of the core.

BigFloorTileGemstone.name: Stone tile "Gemstone"
BigFloorTileGemstone.description: A giant stone tile decorated with a deep blue glass. It depicts a glowing gemstone.

BigFloorTileCaveling.name: Stone tile "Cavelings"
BigFloorTileCaveling.description: A giant stone tile decorated with a deep blue glass. It depicts a gathering of cavelings.

BigFloorTileScholar.name: Stone tile "Scholar"
BigFloorTileScholar.description: A giant stone tile decorated with a deep blue glass. It depicts a robed caveling.

InfoBoardSmall.name: Small Holoboard
InfoBoardSmall.description: A vertical panel made from blue glass. The flickering glyphs on it almost appear like a city map.

InfoBoardLarge.name: Large Holoboard
InfoBoardLarge.description: A vertical large panel made from blue glass. The flickering glyphs on it almost appear like some kind of advertisement.

InfoBoardBroken.name: Broken Holoboard
InfoBoardBroken.description: A broken panel made from blue glass. It's hard to make out the flickering glyphs on it.

RuinsTable.name: Big Gold-edged Table
RuinsTable.description: A big sturdy table hewn from a giant stone slab. There is a lot of space for many people.

RuinsTableSmall.name: Gold-edged Table
RuinsTableSmall.description: A sturdy table hewn from a giant stone slab. There is a lot of space for many people.

RuinsStool.name: Caveling Stool
RuinsStool.description: This stool is made from solid stone but has a comfortable cushion embedded.

RuinsShelfSmall.name: Stone Shelf
RuinsShelfSmall.description: A solid shelf with lots of space for books and scrolls. The ones left in it are unintelligible.

RuinsShelfLarge.name: Large Stone Shelf
RuinsShelfLarge.description: A large solid shelf with lots of space for books and scrolls. The ones left in it are written in a language you don't speak.

RuinsFireplace.name: Caveling Fireplace
RuinsFireplace.description: A solid fireplace with a heavy mantle. It burns with a strange fire that emanates from a gemstone on its bottom.

RuinsCavelingPillar.name: Caveling Pillar
RuinsCavelingPillar.description: A broad stone pillar, depicting an abstract caveling.

VendingMachine.name: Vending Machine
VendingMachine.description: An old, still functioning automaton that is proof of advanced technology and a sophisticated society.

VendingMachineBroken.name: Broken Vending Machine
VendingMachineBroken.description: A broken automaton that once contained snacks and other goods. It looks like it was forced open.

SeaShell.name: Sea Shell
SeaShell.description: A strange shell with a silky-smooth surface.

CityDestructible.name: Metropolis Crate
CityDestructible.description: This precious container holds useful items that have been used by citizens of the ancient city.

SeaWoodenDestructible.name: Driftwood Wooden Crate
SeaWoodenDestructible.description: This box has been created from driftwood and is bleached by light from above.

SurfaceCoral1Large.name: Large Bicolor Coral
SurfaceCoral1Large.description: A large group of two coral species that grow together to form a symbiosis.

SurfaceCoral1Medium.name: Bicolor Coral
SurfaceCoral1Medium.description: A group of two coral species that grow together to form a symbiosis.

SurfaceCoral1Small.name: Small Bicolor Coral
SurfaceCoral1Small.description: A small group of two coral species that grow together to form a symbiosis.

SurfaceCoral2Large.name: Large Crimson Coral
SurfaceCoral2Large.description: A large branchy coral that provides protection and food for small sea critters.

SurfaceCoral2Small.name: Crimson Coral
SurfaceCoral2Small.description: A small branchy coral that provides protection and food for small sea critters.

SurfaceCoral3Large.name: Large Dish Coral
SurfaceCoral3Large.description: A large coral that develops a wide brim above the water surface, providing a safe island for small organisms.

SurfaceCoral3Small.name: Dish Coral
SurfaceCoral3Small.description: A small coral that develops a wide brim above the water surface, providing a safe island for small organisms.

DesertDestructible.name: Desert Flower Vessel
DesertDestructible.description: A dry plant containing natural loot from the desert.

LavaWoodenDestructible.name: Charred Crate
LavaWoodenDestructible.description: This wooden crate has been blackened by a scorching environment.

DesertTempleDestructible.name: Temple Crate
DesertTempleDestructible.description: An ancient crate filled with goods of an old desert civilization.

GreenDesertDestructible.name: Oasis Flower Vessel
GreenDesertDestructible.description: A healthy plant containing natural loot from the desert.

DesertBush.name: Desert Shrub
DesertBush.description: A dry bush that can live hundreds of years without water.

DesertRock2Left.name: Large Left-Facing Rock Arc
DesertRock2Left.description: A large sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

DesertRock3Right.name: Giant Right-Facing Rock Arc
DesertRock3Right.description: A giant sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

PlumeTree.name: Plume Tree
PlumeTree.description: This tree has rock-hard bark and deep roots to gain and hold water from the desert grounds. Its leaves grow in puffy bundles.

ScarabWingcover.name: Scarab Wingcover
ScarabWingcover.description: The wing carapace of a Bomb Scarab resembling half a skull.

TemplePillar.name: Temple Pillar
TemplePillar.description: A very beautiful, decorative pillar only found in ancient desert temples.

TempleGlyphWall1.name: Angled Glyph Wall
TempleGlyphWall1.description: An ancient sandstone wall with an angled top and covered in indecipherable glyphs. What stories do they tell?

TempleGlyphWall2.name: Glyph Wall
TempleGlyphWall2.description: An ancient sandstone wall covered in indecipherable glyphs. What stories do they tell?

SmallTempleRug.name: Temple Decor Rug
SmallTempleRug.description: A small, ancient rug caked with the dust of thousands of years. The design on it shows a trinity of eyes.

LargeTempleRug.name: Large Temple Decor Rug
LargeTempleRug.description: A large, ancient rug with a very detailed design woven into it. It must once have been an expensive item and a sign of prosperity.

TempleGuardianStatue.name: Temple Guardian Statue
TempleGuardianStatue.description: This intimidating statue depicts an ancient guardian in exotic garment. Its kneeling pose hints at being in service of a king.

TempleGuardianStatueRaided.name: Raided Temple Guardian Statue
TempleGuardianStatueRaided.description: A statue wilfully destroyed by grave thiefs. It has been partially relieved of the green daggers in its stony clasp.

TempleGlyphBlock.name: Glyph Stele
TempleGlyphBlock.description: A block made from hazy blue glass with golden etchings. It seems like these were used as memorials or to mark places of importance.

TempleGlyphBlockBroken.name: Broken Glyph Stele
TempleGlyphBlockBroken.description: A block made from hazy blue glass with golden etchings. The information written on it is lost forever as it has been smashed on purpose.

TempleThrone.name: Temple Throne
TempleThrone.description: A golden throne reserved only for the buttocks of ancient royalty.

TemplePedestal.name: Temple Pedestal
TemplePedestal.description: An ancient golden stand that seems to have held royal belongings once.

TempleAzeosUrn.name: Azeos Urn
TempleAzeosUrn.description: This decorative vase has been made in honor of Azeos, the Sky Titan.

TempleRaAkarUrn.name: Ra-Akar Urn
TempleRaAkarUrn.description: This decorative vase has been made in honor of Ra-Akar, the Sand Titan.

TempleOmorothUrn.name: Omoroth Urn
TempleOmorothUrn.description: This decorative vase has been made in honor of Omoroth, the Sea Titan.

EmptyGrave.name: Raided Grave
EmptyGrave.description: Its emptiness is proof of the blasphemous acts of grave raiders.

BrokenGrave.name: Damaged Grave
BrokenGrave.description: A partially broken grave that either survived the currents of time or a quick attempt to gain treasure.

IntactGrave.name: Servant Grave
IntactGrave.description: This grave made from stone shows the relief of an ancient caveling in service of the kingdom that once persisted in the desert.

TiltedGrave.name: Tilted Grave
TiltedGrave.description: An empty grave that has been moved out of its alignment in search for valuables.

LavaRock.name: Lava Rock
LavaRock.description: You're not sure why you did this...but at least you now have a very hot rock.

EmberPit.name: Coal Pit
EmberPit.description: Ashen residue suggests it was once used to temper metal in its fires for many years.

SmithingBellow.name: Old Smithing Bellow
SmithingBellow.description: An old device used to circulate air into a forge to create extreme temperatures. The lever for its mechanism is rusted in place.

LavaPost1.name: Broken Quarry Timber
LavaPost1.description: One half of a broken wooden construction that seemed to have once held something in place.

LavaPost2.name: Large Quarry Timber
LavaPost2.description: A wooden construction used to keep ore and rocks above a fire. A surge in temperatures rendered it unusable.

Wheelbarrow.name: Old Wheelbarrow
Wheelbarrow.description: A broken wheelbarrow stuck in its own molten contents. It seems like it couldn't withstand the extreme heat.

DesertRock2Right.name: Large Right-Facing Rock Arc
DesertRock2Right.description: A large sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

DesertRock3Left.name: Giant Left-Facing Rock Arc
DesertRock3Left.description: A giant sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

LiquidMetalBasin.name: Amalgam Basin
LiquidMetalBasin.description: A natural rock formation with volcanic activity. Its connection to the earth's depths allowed it to form a special kind of metal.

LiquidMetalVent.name: Amalgam Vent
LiquidMetalVent.description: A side-formation of the Amalgam Basin that gets rid of built up heat.

VoidNeuronRobotBoss.name: Herald Void Neuron
VoidNeuronRobotBoss.description: A glowing cell that phases through itself, twisted and pulled as if tethered to an unseen presence. Once part of S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s containment core, it now transmits a distorted echo of the same signal.

AlienTechDestructible.name: Alien Tech Crate
AlienTechDestructible.description: A breakable box that is not from this world. It contains extraterrestrial goods.

CrystalDestructible.name: Sun Crystal
CrystalDestructible.description: A fragile crystal growth that shimmers like the sun. You can see items encased within.

CrystalCicada.name: Failed Titan
CrystalCicada.description: A rare specimen of a colossal cicada that would have become a titan. But due to becoming corrupted with crystals inside its husk, it died when it tried to finally emerge.

LucentOakTree.name: Lucent Oak
LucentOakTree.description: What once seemed to have been a normal tree got permeated by crystals, turning it into a living work of art.

TallCrystalGrass.name: Tall Crystal Grass
TallCrystalGrass.description: A tall, strange growth that consists of broad, transparent leaves.

SmallCrystalGrass.name: Crystal Grass
SmallCrystalGrass.description: A strange growth that consists of broad, transparent leaves.

CrystalTent.name: Crystal Tent
CrystalTent.description: The crystallized, makeshift resting place of a former explorer. They don't have much use for each other anymore.

RadiationCrystal.name: Radiation Crystal
RadiationCrystal.description: A culmination of radioactive elements that resulted in a glass-like structure.

GeodeWallDisplay.name: Geode Wall Display
GeodeWallDisplay.description: A cleanly cut half of a geode. The simple wooden construction underneath allows it to be attached to a wall.

ObeliskSmall.name: Small Obelisk
ObeliskSmall.description: A descriptive stele, carved into stone. The runes on it are indecipherable.

ObeliskTall.name: Tall Obelisk
ObeliskTall.description: A large descriptive stele, carved into stone. The runes on it are indecipherable.

SingingCrystal.name: Singing Crystal
SingingCrystal.description: Due to its shape, this naturally formed crystal rings with a harmonic frequency when struck.

AlienTechSpire.name: Dysfunctional Coil
AlienTechSpire.description: A piece of alien technology that seems to have burned out.

AlienTechCrystalLight.name: Alien Crystal Light
AlienTechCrystalLight.description: A highly advanced light using a giant ancient gemstone. It almost appears like an oversized torch made for something with even larger hands.

AlienFloorVent.name: Alien Floor Vent
AlienFloorVent.description: A piece of tech that would still be functional, had it not been ripped out of the floor by greedy hands.

AlienObeliskSmall.name: Small Alien Obelisk
AlienObeliskSmall.description: A descriptive stele, carved into mysterious stone. Its meaning is beyond earthly understanding.

AlienObeliskTall.name: Tall Alien Obelisk
AlienObeliskTall.description: A large descriptive stele, carved into mysterious stone. Its meaning is beyond earthly understanding.

SulfurTree.name: Sulfur Tree
SulfurTree.description: This gnarled tree feasts on the organic matter of the passage. It sprouts glowing sacs of toxic gas.

SulfurBud.name: Sulfur Bud
SulfurBud.description: A sapling grows inside this fragile bulb of toxic gas. The lightest touch can make it burst!

FeatherTree.name: Purple Feather Tree
FeatherTree.description: Not a tree at all, but a tall invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its long arms.

SmallFeatherTree.name: Small Purple Feather Tree
SmallFeatherTree.description: Not a tree at all, but an invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its arms. It hasn't fully matured yet.

FeatherTreeCyan.name: Cyan Feather Tree
FeatherTreeCyan.description: Not a tree at all, but a tall invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its long arms.

SmallFeatherTreeCyan.name: Small Cyan Feather Tree
SmallFeatherTreeCyan.description: Not a tree at all, but an invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its arms. It hasn't fully matured yet.

TallBarnacleGrass.name: Tall Barnacle Grass
TallBarnacleGrass.description: A large group of long-necked barnacles stretching out from the ground.

SmallBarnacleGrass.name: Barnacle Grass
SmallBarnacleGrass.description: A small group of long-necked barnacles stretching out from the ground.

PandoriumCrystal.name: Pandorium Crystal
PandoriumCrystal.description: This large crystal formation pops and sputters with chaotic energy.

SmallPandoriumCrystal.name: Small Pandorium Crystal
SmallPandoriumCrystal.description: This small crystal formation pops and sputters with chaotic energy.

PassageDestructible.name: Fossil Cluster
PassageDestructible.description: Stacks of calcified marine fossils. There may be some resources inside.

LargePassageDestructible.name: Large Fossil Cluster
LargePassageDestructible.description: A heaping pile of calcified marine fossils. There may be some resources inside.

PassageCraftingStatue.name: Rift Statue
PassageCraftingStatue.description: This statue opens a rift to a mysterious entity. It seems willing to trade.

GrimyStonePillar.name: Grimy Stone Pillar
GrimyStonePillar.description: This sullied pillar is covered in intricate... monstrous carvings.

GrimyStoneFloor.name: Grimy Stone Floor
GrimyStoneFloor.description: A floor made of dark, grimy stone bricks.

StoneLantern.name: Stone Lantern
StoneLantern.description: An unknown light source sits inside this solid stone cage. The air around it feels cold.

OasisStalagmite.name: Oasis Stalagmite
OasisStalagmite.description: A solid humid pillar, coated with adrift red sand settling over the centuries.

OasisSucculent.name: Gilded Aloe
OasisSucculent.description: This lovely succulent has not yet fully bloomed.

OasisSucculentLarge.name: Large Gilded Aloe
OasisSucculentLarge.description: A resilient succulent that thrives in humid environments.

WaterReed.name: Water Reed
WaterReed.description: Has a sweet smelling pollen irresistible to insects.

CultistColossCicada.name: Colossal Cicada
CultistColossCicada.description: A fully grown colossal cicada that seems to have met an unfortunate end.

PlayerGrave.name: Tombstone
PlayerGrave.description: Now that the worst is over, use it to decorate!

Lever.name: Lever
Lever.description: Generates a low amount of electricity that can be turned on and off.

ElectricalWire.name: Electrical Wire
ElectricalWire.description: Connects sources of electricity to machines and apparatuses.

ElectricalDoor.name: Electrical Door
ElectricalDoor.description: Opens up when powered by electricity.

LogicCircuit.name: Logic Circuit
LogicCircuit.description: Electricity can move through the circuit when it receives electricity on exactly 2 out of 3 inputs.

PulseCircuit.name: Pulse Circuit
PulseCircuit.description: Electricity moves through in intervals of 1 second.

DelayCircuit.name: Delay Circuit
DelayCircuit.description: Stores electricity input and sends it out during intervals of 1 second.

ElectricityStick.name: Electricity Stick
ElectricityStick.description: Emits a very low electricity that is too low to power up objects but useful to change behavior of logic circuits.

DynamitePack.name: Dynamite Pack
DynamitePack.description: This tight pack of explosives can be detonated in safety with an external trigger.

PressurePlate.name: Pressure Plate
PressurePlate.description: Generates a low amount of electricity when stepped on by the player.

CrossCircuit.name: Cross Circuit
CrossCircuit.description: Separates horizontal and vertical wires. Allows crossing wires without connecting the electricity. Connection directions change by rotating the circuit while holding it.

EnemySpawnerPlatform.name: Materializer
EnemySpawnerPlatform.description: This incredible device is able to weave free matter into a temporary living being when charged with electricity. Requires a figurine as blueprint.

WayPoint.name: Ancient Waypoint
WayPoint.description: A miraculous gemstone device used to teleport to other waypoints and portals. When placed, it takes 10 minutes to charge up before it can be accessed.

RemoteExplosive.name: Remote Explosive Pack
RemoteExplosive.description: A neat pack of boom, remote-operated and safety-approved... probably. Don't lose the remote.

PlayerProximitySensor.name: Explorer Proximity Sensor
PlayerProximitySensor.description: A sensor that responds to the presence of humans.

UndergroundElectricityGenerator.name: Lowered Electricity Generator
UndergroundElectricityGenerator.description: Powers wires and objects with electricity and is beneath floor-level.

ElectricalDropGate.name: Electrical Drop Gate
ElectricalDropGate.description: Opens from below when powered by electricity. Can be placed in water and doesn't require walls.

HostileCreatureProximitySensor.name: Enemy Proximity Sensor
HostileCreatureProximitySensor.description: A sensor that responds to the presence of hostile creatures.

KinematicDynamo.name: Kinematic Dynamo
KinematicDynamo.description: Emits a low charge of electricity when struck. Equally sturdy and responsive.

TCircuit.name: T Circuit
TCircuit.description: A circuit that takes directs electricity from 1 direction into 2 other directions.

LCircuit.name: L Circuit
LCircuit.description: A circuit that directs electricity through a right angle.

ICircuit.name: I Circuit
ICircuit.description: A circuit that directs electricity in a straight line exclusively.

Rail.name: Rail
Rail.description: Traverse the underground world much faster.

Minecart.name: Minecart
Minecart.description: Allows riding the railways with high speed.

SpeederBoat.name: Speeder
SpeederBoat.description: Allows traveling over water much faster.

SpeederGoKart.name: Speeder Go-kart
SpeederGoKart.description: A racing kart with a nice red finish, able to outrace other vehicles after a longer acceleration time. Tends to drift a lot when driving too fast.

RenegadeGoKart.name: Renegade Go-kart
RenegadeGoKart.description: An off-road vehicle that provides quick acceleration but lower top-speed. It looks slightly busted but lets you take curves in a more stable manner.

PrimitiveGoKart.name: Primitive Go-kart
PrimitiveGoKart.description: An ancient vehicle built by the lost civilization, seemingly for pure fun. It provides only a fraction of the speed it once was capable of.

HiveSpikeTrap.name: Hive Spike Trap
HiveSpikeTrap.description: A larva hive trap made out of sharp bones, damaging any creature who steps on it.

SpikeTrap.name: Spike Trap
SpikeTrap.description: A mechanical spike trap that only reacts to enemies.

PoisonTrap.name: Poison Spike Trap
PoisonTrap.description: A mechanical spike trap that reacts to anyone stepping on it and additionally applies poison when inflicting damage.

GalaxiteTrap.name: Galaxite Trap
GalaxiteTrap.description: This high-tech trap shoots out a jet of energy that burns with different temperatures, resulting in a rainbow flame.

WoodSpikeTrap.name: Wooden Spike Trap
WoodSpikeTrap.description: A crude spike trap that only reacts to enemies.

Drill.name: Drill
Drill.description: Can slowly drill through tougher materials such as ore boulders when powered by electricity. Drills drilling together yield better results.

RobotArm.name: Robot Arm
RobotArm.description: A mechanical helping hand, grabs things and puts them elsewhere when powered by electricity. Filtering can be enabled to only handle matching items.

Sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
Sprinkler.description: A useful gadget that waters tilled ground in a small radius.

TempleTurret.name: Stone Turret
TempleTurret.description: This ancient trap shoots projectiles at anyone walking into its line of sight. Its inner workings are concealed by a caveling grimace.

GalaxiteTurret.name: Galaxite Turret
GalaxiteTurret.description: An automated high-tech gun that shoots enemies it faces with energy projectiles. Requires electricity to function.

CrudeDrill.name: Crude Drill
CrudeDrill.description: Can very slowly drill through tougher materials such as ore boulders when powered by electricity. Drills drilling together yield better results.

SeedExtractor.name: Seed Extractor
SeedExtractor.description: Extracts and reclaims seeds from plants when powered by electricity.

RobotFarmArm.name: Robot Farm Arm
RobotFarmArm.description: A mechanical farm arm that plants seeds and harvests crops when powered by electricity. Does not drop seeds, unlike manual harvest.

Shredder.name: Shredder
Shredder.description: When powered by electricity, automatically scraps tools, equipment and other things you don't need.

Incinerator.name: Incinerator
Incinerator.description: Processes items to be forever destroyed when powered by electricity.

ItemCollector.name: Item Collector
ItemCollector.description: Collects items within its detection range when powered by electricity.

FlamethrowerTurret.name: Flame Turret
FlamethrowerTurret.description: Continuously sprays fire in its facing direction while powered. Requires electricity to function.

GrimyStoneBookshelf.name: Grimy Bookshelf
GrimyStoneBookshelf.description: A set of stony rows lined with worn jagged books.

GrimyStoneBookshelfLarge.name: Large Grimy Bookshelf
GrimyStoneBookshelfLarge.description: A grand shelf hosting a vast library of grayed tomes.

GrimyStoneTable.name: Grimy Table
GrimyStoneTable.description: A dimly moss-colored table with dust sticking to its damp surface.

AFScienceHelm.name: Makeshift Goggles
AFScienceHelm.description: Monocular night vision made from various scientific gadgetry.

AFScienceBreastArmor.name: Researcher's Coat
AFScienceBreastArmor.description: A specialized lab coat faintly tinged with radiation. It's probably harmless.

AFSciencePantsArmor.name: Researcher's Pants
AFSciencePantsArmor.description: A pair of pale leggings designed to idle on office chairs, yet perfectly fit for outrunning extradimensional horrors.

AFWhiteBoard.name: Whiteboard
AFWhiteBoard.description: A whiteboard covered with convoluted, scribbled equations.

AFWaterCooler.name: Water Cooler
AFWaterCooler.description: A jug-based water cooler, great for holding and dispensing liquids.

AFBottledAnomaly.name: Bottled Anomaly
AFBottledAnomaly.description: Contains an indecipherable entity that appears to respond to glass.

AFVendingMachine.name: Snacks Vending Machine
AFVendingMachine.description: A snack dispenser with contents in surprisingly fresh condition.

AFWoodenDestructible.name: Office Crate
AFWoodenDestructible.description: A box arbitrarily stocked with research items.

AFPipeClub.name: Pipe Club
AFPipeClub.description: A hefty pipe with a gauge on the end for added weight.

AFQuillRifle.name: Quill Rifle
AFQuillRifle.description: A re-engineered bioweapon, discharging quills as deadly bolts.

AFDrink2.name: Rootbear
AFDrink2.description: This soda tastes like licorice, or something worse.

AFDrink4.name: Slushie
AFDrink4.description: An ice cold beverage with a kick of flavor. May cause a slight chill.

AFDrink5.name: Mug of Coffee
AFDrink5.description: A highly caffeinated drink. Sure to knock some fatigue off.

AFDrink6.name: Kizz Cola
AFDrink6.description: A strange soda, from a strange vending machine.

AFPortal.name: Anteverse Portal
AFPortal.description: Gadgetry labeled "GATE" that suspends a humming entryway. The rims of its rift depict a laboratorial place of origin, which has been eclipsed by a tether to the Core.

AFPestElectricTrophy.name: Electro-Pest Figurine
AFPestElectricTrophy.description: A lifelike representation of an Electro-Pest.

ImmuneZoneEmitterLarge.name: Superior Ward Coil
ImmuneZoneEmitterLarge.description: This object emits a very vast warding zone, imbuing structures inside with aberrant permanence. It prevents object placement, destruction, and limits interaction.

ImmuneZoneEmitterMedium.name: Greater Ward Coil
ImmuneZoneEmitterMedium.description: This object emits a vast warding zone, imbuing structures inside with aberrant permanence. It prevents object placement, destruction, and limits interaction.

ImmuneZoneEmitter.name: Ward Coil
