ImmuneZoneEmitter.description: This object emits a warding zone, imbuing structures inside with aberrant permanence. It prevents object placement, destruction, and limits interaction.

ExplosiveBarrel.name: Explosive Barrel
ExplosiveBarrel.description: A barrel packed with unstable materials. The seal is holding, but it feels like it's only a matter of time.

WallThermostat.name: Wall Thermostat
WallThermostat.description: Measures heat... while in doing so emitting its own.

WallGauge.name: Wall Gauge
WallGauge.description: Measures the thickness of the wall behind it, though its hand fluctuates.

WallMetalSheet.name: Wall Metal Sheet
WallMetalSheet.description: Haphazard sheets bolted with screws used for a last-ditch-effort of patchwork.

ExcavationSign.name: Excavation Sign
ExcavationSign.description: A fancy brass-coated waymark for the lost.

MetalBarrel.name: Metal Barrel
MetalBarrel.description: A barrel for hazardous waste. It is firmly sealed for better or worse.

ExcavationDestructibleReinforcedBox.name: Reinforced Industrial Box
ExcavationDestructibleReinforcedBox.description: A metallic box once meant for tool storage. Its reinforcement has rusted and weakened over time.

ExcavationDestructibleSteelBox.name: Metal Industrial Box
ExcavationDestructibleSteelBox.description: A metallic box once meant for tool storage. Its previously sturdy latches have deteriorated over time.

MetalBarricade.name: Metal Barricade
MetalBarricade.description: A reliable metal barricade keeping curiosity and chaos apart.

MetalPallet.name: Metal Pallet
MetalPallet.description: A heavy metal pallet built for hauling gear and supplies.

DeadTree.name: Dull Tree
DeadTree.description: A dreary tree with crooked branches that have long lost its leaves.

ColumnMonument.name: Column Monument
ColumnMonument.description: A tall, dusty pillar decorated with sigils of crossed hammers.

SahabarMonument.name: Sahabar Monument
SahabarMonument.description: A majestic likeness of a prophet holding a pickaxe cast in copper.

GearMonument.name: Gear Monument
GearMonument.description: A sculpted cog given sanctified portrayal.

DrillMonument.name: Drill Monument
DrillMonument.description: A sculpted drill given sanctified portrayal.

InventoryExcavationBiomeChest.name: Plain Chest
InventoryExcavationBiomeChest.description: Who ever said storage containers need to be complex?

ExcavationStatue.name: Pious Caveling Monument
ExcavationStatue.description: A colossal likeness of a caveling in vaguely monastic garb.

ExcavationPedestal.name: Industrial Pedestal
ExcavationPedestal.description: A steelclad pedestal with hints of rust. Nobody would place something hazardous atop something so accessible, right?

CandleStick.name: Aether Candelabra
CandleStick.description: A tall candelabrum hosting three candlelike burners. Its esoteric material emits a purple flame.

ValuableExcavationRobotLeg.name: Geobot Leg
ValuableExcavationRobotLeg.description: A geobot's discarded limb, somehow in excellent condition. It has just enough charge left to curl and splay on its own.

ValuableExcavationDisabledDataPad.name: Disabled Datapad
ValuableExcavationDisabledDataPad.description: A beeping tablet that won't respond to your inputs. Someone else might find use for it.

ValuableExcavationTotem.name: Sahabar Idol
ValuableExcavationTotem.description: A small totem with gilded details in the likeness of a prophet. To some its price would be too sacred to place. To others it is high.

HydraBossVoidChest.name: Oblidra Chest
HydraBossVoidChest.description: An intimidating chest that's reminiscent of Oblidra the Void Lord.

AzeosFeatherFan.name: Azeos Feather Fan
AzeosFeatherFan.description: A beautiful fan created in honor of Azeos that appears to create wind without swinging it. A gift worthy of a queen.

OmorothCompass.name: Omoroth Compass
OmorothCompass.description: A splendid tool for seafaring created in honor of Omoroth, anyone possessing it will never feel lost at sea. A gift worthy of a king.

RaAkarAutomaton.name: Ra-Akar Automaton
RaAkarAutomaton.description: A complex wind-up machine created in honor of Ra-Akar that seems to have a mind of its own. A gift worthy of a young prince.

InstrumentHarp.name: Harp
InstrumentHarp.description: Simply gliding the fingertips across its fine strings results in a harmonic sound vibrating through the air.

InstrumentCello.name: Cello
InstrumentCello.description: A string instrument made from wood. It's not a world-class creation but good enough to fill the silent caves with harmony.

InstrumentFlute.name: Flute
InstrumentFlute.description: A fine wind instrument producing a whistling sound. Can be tricky to master.

InstrumentDrumkit.name: Drumkit
InstrumentDrumkit.description: An instrument that annoys the neighbors but induces irresistible rhythm when played correctly.

InstrumentPiano.name: Pocket Piano
InstrumentPiano.description: This transportable key instrument can be played solo or as a nice addition to an orchestra.

Milk.name: Meadow Milk
Milk.description: A bottle of milk with a slight vanilla aroma and an earthy aftertaste.

Meat.name: Marbled Meat
Meat.description: A thick slab of meat, waiting to be simmered and seasoned.

Egg.name: Dodo Egg
Egg.description: A large egg protected by an ivory shell. Safe for consumption!

HeartBerrySeed.name: Heart Berry Seed
HeartBerrySeed.description: Grows into a healthy fruit when planted.

HeartBerry.name: Heart Berry
HeartBerry.description: A sweet, juicy berry that refreshes the body.

GlowingTulipSeed.name: Glow Tulip Seed
GlowingTulipSeed.description: Grows into a luminescent flower when planted.

GlowingTulipFlower.name: Glow Tulip
GlowingTulipFlower.description: A precious, shimmering flower that absorbed ancient energy.

BombPepperSeed.name: Bomb Pepper Seed
BombPepperSeed.description: Grows into a spicy vegetable when planted.

BombPepper.name: Bomb Pepper
BombPepper.description: A fierce vegetable for spicing up foods.

CarrockSeed.name: Carrock Seed
CarrockSeed.description: A tough seed that only grows in prepared stone.

Carrock.name: Carrock
Carrock.description: Rock-hard vegetable that toughens you up.

PuffungiSeed.name: Puffungi Seed
PuffungiSeed.description: A seed that only grows in prepared mold.

Puffungi.name: Puffungi
Puffungi.description: A moldy fungus fit for gourmets.

RootSeed.name: Root Seed
RootSeed.description: Once planted it spreads roots in every direction.

GrubKapokSeed.name: Grub Kapok Seed
GrubKapokSeed.description: Turns into a plant that gives fiber when harvested.

CoralRootSeed.name: Coral Wood Seed
CoralRootSeed.description: Once planted it spreads corals in every direction. Can only be planted on prepared beach sand.

BloatOatSeed.name: Bloat Oat Seed
BloatOatSeed.description: Grows into a filling crop when planted.

BloatOat.name: Bloat Oat
BloatOat.description: A handful of healthy cereal that fills you up and gives you energy.

PewpayaSeed.name: Pewpaya Seed
PewpayaSeed.description: Grows into a juicy fruit when planted in beach sand.

Pewpaya.name: Pewpaya
Pewpaya.description: A juicy, sweet fruit that clears your mind and raises focus.

PinegrappleSeed.name: Pinegrapple Seed
PinegrappleSeed.description: Grows into a refreshing sour and sweet fruit when planted in prepared beach sand.

Pinegrapple.name: Pinegrapple
Pinegrapple.description: An intensely tasty fruit that has you clench your weapons tightly.

GrumpkinSeed.name: Grumpkin Seed
GrumpkinSeed.description: Grows into a lumpy fruit when planted.

Grumpkin.name: Grumpkin
Grumpkin.description: A lumpy fruit that looks very annoyed with having been pulled from the soil.

SunriceSeed.name: Sunrice Seed
SunriceSeed.description: Grows into a bracing crop when planted. Only grows in prepared crystal ground.

Sunrice.name: Sunrice
Sunrice.description: A vibrant crop that braces you for tough encounters.

LunacornSeed.name: Lunacorn Seed
LunacornSeed.description: Grows into an inspiriting crop when planted. Only grows in prepared crystal ground.

Lunacorn.name: Lunacorn
Lunacorn.description: A mealy, colorful crop that increases your toughness.

GleamRootSeed.name: Gleam Wood Seed
GleamRootSeed.description: Once planted it spreads glowing roots in every direction. Can only be planted on prepared crystal ground.

HeartBerryRare.name: Golden Heart Berry
HeartBerryRare.description: A very rare variant of the common heart berry.

GlowingTulipFlowerRare.name: Golden Glow Tulip
GlowingTulipFlowerRare.description: A very rare variant of the common glow tulip.

BombPepperRare.name: Golden Bomb Pepper
BombPepperRare.description: A very rare variant of the common bomb pepper.

CarrockRare.name: Golden Carrock
CarrockRare.description: A very rare variant of the common carrock.

PuffungiRare.name: Golden Puffungi
PuffungiRare.description: A very rare variant of the common puffungi.

BloatOatRare.name: Golden Bloat Oat
BloatOatRare.description: A very rare variant of the common bloat oat.

PewpayaRare.name: Golden Pewpaya
PewpayaRare.description: A very rare variant of the common pewpaya.

PinegrappleRare.name: Golden Pinegrapple
PinegrappleRare.description: A very rare variant of the common pinegrapple.

GrumpkinRare.name: Golden Grumpkin
GrumpkinRare.description: A very rare variant of the common grumpkin.

SunriceRare.name: Golden Sunrice
SunriceRare.description: A very rare variant of the common sunrice.

LunacornRare.name: Golden Lunacorn
LunacornRare.description: A very rare variant of the common lunacorn.

RecallIdol.name: Recall Idol
RecallIdol.description: Teleports you back to the core, consumed in the process.

HiveMotherScanner.name: Hive Mother Scanner
HiveMotherScanner.description: Scans the world for the Hive Mother. Consumed on successful scan.

LarvaBossScanner.name: Ghorm the Devourer Scanner
LarvaBossScanner.description: Scans the world for Ghorm the Devourer. Consumed on successful scan.

ShamanBossScanner.name: Malugaz the Corrupted Scanner
ShamanBossScanner.description: Scans the world for Malugaz the Corrupted. Consumed on successful scan.

BirdBossScanner.name: Azeos the Sky Titan Scanner
BirdBossScanner.description: Scans the world for Azeos the Sky Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

PoisonSlimeBossScanner.name: Ivy the Poisonous Mass Scanner
PoisonSlimeBossScanner.description: Scans the world for Ivy the Poisonous Mass. Consumed on successful scan.

OctopusBossScanner.name: Omoroth the Sea Titan Scanner

GiantCicadaBossScanner.description: Scans the world for Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands. Consumed on successful scan.

LegendarySwordParchment.name: Rune Parchment
LegendarySwordParchment.description: An unusually well preserved piece of ancient paper. The runes are impossible to decipher but small symbols hint at it being the recipe for a strange weapon.

LegendaryBowParchment.name: Glyph Parchment
LegendaryBowParchment.description: An unusually well preserved piece of ancient paper. There are glyphs and images on it that show how to forge a powerful ancient weapon.

ProtocolSlate.name: Empty Crystal
ProtocolSlate.description: A rhombus-shaped crystal made from glass that has complex circuits embedded. It seems powered down, maybe it could be fed data to activate it again?

ProtocolSlateKey.name: Admin Key
ProtocolSlateKey.description: A reactivated key belonging to a wise leader. It may open the door to something very valuable.

LegendaryMiningPickParchment.name: Cipher Parchment
LegendaryMiningPickParchment.description: An unusually well preserved scroll made from golden paper. Among the blue edged runes are drawings of an ancient forge resembling the face of a caveling.

BindingString.name: Thread of Fate
BindingString.description: A mysterious string woven from fine filaments. It can be used to bind a set of cards together.

LegendaryMortarParchment.name: Schematic Parchment
LegendaryMortarParchment.description: A well preserved but complicated blueprint. Its pictographs with exotic numerals outline steps in assembling a devastating weapon.

HydraBossVoidScanner.name: Oblidra the Void Lord Scanner
HydraBossVoidScanner.description: Scans the world for Oblidra the Void Lord. Consumed on successful scan.

RobotBossScanner.name: S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Scanner
RobotBossScanner.description: Scans the world for S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Consumed on successful scan.

EchoMapFishingMerchant.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

EchoMapWorshipMural.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

EchoMapShrineRoom.description: A disc with coordinates for a sealed chamber. Consumed on successful scan.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.description: A small, useful light that leaves your hands free.

OrbLantern.name: Orb Lantern
OrbLantern.description: A better, brighter source of light to attach to your belt.

SmallLantern.name: Small Lantern
SmallLantern.description: A weak light to attach to your belt.

PumpkinLantern.name: Pumpkin Lantern
PumpkinLantern.description: A scary, yet cozy lantern carved from a fruit. Don't smash it, it brings bad luck.

PearlLantern.name: Pearl Lantern
PearlLantern.description: A shimmering blue pearl in a scallop that illuminates your path above the dark depths of the sea.

SoulLantern.name: Soul Lantern
SoulLantern.description: A vessel with a hot, oil-like substance within.

WoodShield.name: Wooden Shield
WoodShield.description: A useful off-hand item to block hits from enemies.

PoisonousShield.name: Toxic Defender
PoisonousShield.description: A shield covered in toxic grime. Has a chance to poison enemies when blocking attacks.

OctarineShield.name: Octarine Shield
OctarineShield.description: An extremely durable shield infused with energy that increases health while holding it.

IronShield.name: Iron Shield
IronShield.description: A heraldic shield offering significant protection from attacks.

MinionDetonator.name: Minion Detonator
MinionDetonator.description: A pristine skull crest turning conjured sparks of life into ones of greater death.

MinionDetonatorMinor.name: Minion Kindler
MinionDetonatorMinor.description: A rusted skull crest turning conjured sparks of life into ones of lesser death.

SwiftFeather.name: Swift Feather
SwiftFeather.description: A mysterious feather that allows you to dash out of danger.

AzeosSwiftFeather.name: Azeos' Dash Feather
AzeosSwiftFeather.description: A colorful talon feather from Azeos, the Sky Titan. By holding it you can dash at a high speed.

CavelingSkinTome.name: Blue Leather Tome
CavelingSkinTome.description: An ancient book with stitched blue covers. Is that skin?

GoldenJellyfish.name: Golden Jellyfish
GoldenJellyfish.description: This rare jellyfish seems to do well without water and apparently it likes your company.

CavelingID.name: Caveling ID
CavelingID.description: A sturdy card that once belonged to a citizen of the forlorn metropolis. It's thousand of years old but the excellent print hasn't faded.

TurtleShell.name: Turtle Shell
TurtleShell.description: A hard shell that once belonged to a graceful sea creature. You feel much more protected when holding it.

OmorothBeak.name: Omoroth's Beak
OmorothBeak.description: The sharp mouth piece of Omoroth, the Sea Titan. It seems to be able to crush every material.

GolemShield.name: Sentry Shield
GolemShield.description: The discarded breast piece of a core sentry. It has just the right size to be used as a great shield and the ancient gemstone in its center sometimes shoots out energy as it blocks enemy attacks.

RoyalGel.name: Royal Gel
RoyalGel.description: A blob of slime with a tiny crown in its center. With the right headpiece you can reign over all slimes.

CrystalMeteorShardOffhand.name: Crystal Meteor Chunk
CrystalMeteorShardOffhand.description: A very big ancient gemstone fused from smaller shards. It emits a strange energy that makes you feel nauseous and feverish.

LavaShield.name: Scorching Aegis
LavaShield.description: The crust of molten rock, formed to be wielded like a shield.

ConceiledBlade.name: Concealed Blade
ConceiledBlade.description: A knife attached to a wrist band hidden among layers of fabric. It's perfect for an unsuspected stealth attack.

SmithingGlove.name: Smithing Glove
SmithingGlove.description: Reinforced with several rare materials, this glove can withstand great heat and is a must have for every experienced blacksmith.

OracleDeck.name: Oracle Deck
OracleDeck.description: The complete set of oracle cards. Bringing them together strangely restored the cards to perfect condition and now they emit a powerful, enlightening aura.

CoreEye.name: Core Iris
CoreEye.description: A manufactured crystal that looks like the eye of the core. This one is raw and unfinished, as if something interrupted the process.

PetRock.name: Pet Rock
PetRock.description: It's Bob the pet rock. Don't drop or throw him, he has feelings too.

HydraBoneShield.name: Hydra Bone Shield
HydraBoneShield.description: The heavy top part of a hydra's skull. Made to withstand deep pressure within the earth, it makes for a great protection in battle.

HydraBoneTooth.name: Hydra Tooth
HydraBoneTooth.description: The long fang of a hydra. It emanates a primal energy that is waiting to be harnessed.

TrinityHeartOrbOffhand.name: Trinity Heart
TrinityHeartOrbOffhand.description: A symbiosis of an ancient gemstone with organic matter, resulting in a physically impossible material. It pulsates in energetic rhythms of three, a celestial pattern that must have been of utter importance to a spacefaring species.

RiftLensOffhand.name: Rift Lens
RiftLensOffhand.description: A peculiar handheld device, used for short range teleportation.

MoonstoneOffhand.name: Moonstone
MoonstoneOffhand.description: This pristine crystal is filled with energy. It makes you feel determined.

SummonerOffhand.name: Scratched Stone
SummonerOffhand.description: The claw marks in this rock reveal dormant energies inside, waiting to be awoken.

MagnetOffHand.name: Magnet
MagnetOffHand.description: A magnet with an impressive draw that defies the limits of electromagnetics.

RemoteDetonatorOffHand.name: Remote Boom Clicker
RemoteDetonatorOffHand.description: For when you want to make things go boom, but from a comfy distance!

BaitFishBitesFaster.name: Spicy Lure
BaitFishBitesFaster.description: A well-seasoned type of lure that attracts fish and other things more quickly.

BaitIncreasedChanceToGetFish.name: Sweet Lure
BaitIncreasedChanceToGetFish.description: A sugary type of lure that increases the chance of catching fish instead of loot.

BaitIncreasedChanceToGetFishLoot.name: Glowing Lure
BaitIncreasedChanceToGetFishLoot.description: A luminous type of lure that increases the chance of pulling up loot.

BaitFishStartsCloserToBeReeledIn.name: Sticky Lure
BaitFishStartsCloserToBeReeledIn.description: An icky type of lure that may stick on to fish that didn't even bite.

BaitOctopusBoss.name: Expert Lure
BaitOctopusBoss.description: This lure consists of multiple edible and magical components, attracting the one big catch that lingers in deep waters. Is consumed on successful use.

BaitIncreaseChanceOfHigherRarityFish.name: Purple Lure
BaitIncreaseChanceOfHigherRarityFish.description: A shimmering lure that catches the eye of more rare fish.

BaitFishBitesFasterAndIncreasedChanceToG.name: Green Lure
BaitFishBitesFasterAndIncreasedChanceToG.description: A pointy lure that can stick to fish from the outside to catch more and catch them faster.

BaitFishBitesFasterAndStartsCloserToBeRe.name: Red Lure
BaitFishBitesFasterAndStartsCloserToBeRe.description: A wiggly lure that looks like a red worm, large enough to allow more than one fish to get caught sometimes.

CaveBag.name: Miner Backpack
CaveBag.description: Every underground miner needs one of those!

GhormsStomachBag.name: Ghorm's Stomach Backpack
GhormsStomachBag.description: A well-preserved stomach portion of the Devourer, comes with two handy straps.

ScarletShellBackpack.name: Scarlet Shell Backpack
ScarletShellBackpack.description: A hard-case backpack with lots of space and additional protection.

ExplorerBackpack.name: Explorer Backpack
ExplorerBackpack.description: A simple backpack made for traveling the underground caves. Holds quite a few items.

OctarineBackpack.name: Octarine Backpack
OctarineBackpack.description: A strange backpack that has more space inside than it looks like from the outside.

MorphaBag.name: Morpha's Bubble Bag
MorphaBag.description: An elastic bag with lots of space that formed from one of Morpha's outer growths.

JuteBag.name: Small Backpack
JuteBag.description: A simple backpack, made from smoothened bark.

ScholarBag.name: Scholar Backpack
ScholarBag.description: Has the comforting smell of musty old books.

OreAndBlockPouch.name: Small Ore and Block Pouch
OreAndBlockPouch.description: A small pouch made exclusively for ores and blocks, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

MediumOreAndBlockPouch.name: Medium Ore and Block Pouch
MediumOreAndBlockPouch.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for ores and blocks, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

SeedAndCropsPouch.name: Small Seed and Crop Pouch
SeedAndCropsPouch.description: A small pouch made exclusively for seeds and crops, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

MediumSeedAndCropsPouch.name: Medium Seed and Crop Pouch
MediumSeedAndCropsPouch.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for seeds and crops, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

ValuablePouch.name: Small Valuable Pouch
ValuablePouch.description: A small pouch made exclusively for valuables, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

MediumValuablePouch.name: Medium Valuable Pouch
MediumValuablePouch.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for valuables, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

FishPouch.name: Small Fish Pouch
FishPouch.description: A small pouch made exclusively for fish, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

MediumFishPouch.name: Medium Fish Pouch
MediumFishPouch.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for fish, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

LargeOreAndBlockPouch.name: Large Ore and Block Pouch
LargeOreAndBlockPouch.description: A large pouch made exclusively for ores and blocks, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

LargeSeedAndCropsPouch.name: Large Seed and Crop Pouch
LargeSeedAndCropsPouch.description: A large pouch made exclusively for seeds and crops, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

LargeValuablePouch.name: Large Valuable Pouch
LargeValuablePouch.description: A large pouch made exclusively for valuables, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

LargeFishPouch.name: Large Fish Pouch
LargeFishPouch.description: A large pouch made exclusively for fish, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

CopperHelm.name: Copper Helm
CopperHelm.description: Resembles more of a bucket but repels strong blows to the head.

WoodHelm.name: Wood Helm
WoodHelm.description: Slight protection for the head but you should look for better options soon.

PeasantHelm.name: Peasant Hat
PeasantHelm.description: Simple leather hat, doesn't look that great but does its job.

CavelingHelm.name: Caveling Hood
CavelingHelm.description: Light armor hood that hides the face.

IronHelm.name: Iron Helm
IronHelm.description: Tough helm fit for knights. Comes with a visor and a flamboyant plume.

BronzeHelm.name: Bronze Helm
BronzeHelm.description: This helm repels slight blows to the head.

CarapaceHelm.name: Carapace Helm
CarapaceHelm.description: A chitin-plated head piece, wearing it fills you with the urge to dig paths through the darkness.

LarvaHelm.name: Larva Helm
LarvaHelm.description: No need for fancy hats. Just grub.

ScarletHelm.name: Scarlet Helm
ScarletHelm.description: Menacing-looking horned helm, fits perfectly with the rest of the set.

HunterHelm.name: Hunter Hood
HunterHelm.description: This hood is made from big leaves tucked into a headband. Lets you blend into green environments.

FarmerHelm.name: Farmer's Hat
FarmerHelm.description: Tuck a straw in your mouth and get ready for a whole day of relaxing on the porch.

OctarineHelm.name: Octarine Helm
OctarineHelm.description: A strange headgear with no visor. For some reason you can still see clearly when putting it on.

RadicalRabbitEars.name: Radical Rabbit Ears
RadicalRabbitEars.description: A cute hood featuring white rabbit ears. You feel quite cheeky and swift wearing it.

ScholarHelm.name: Scholar's Hood
ScholarHelm.description: A strange hood made from white linen and gold, in its shade you feel more intelligent than usual.

DiverHelm.name: Diving Helm
DiverHelm.description: This heavy chunk of metal was used to explore deep waters, unfortunately it's leaking now. Still works as a nice armor piece.

SlimeHelm.name: Slime Helm
SlimeHelm.description: A gooey, constantly dripping helm that covers half of your face.

GolemHelm.name: Sentry Helm
GolemHelm.description: The detached head of a core sentry. Wearing it feels incredibly clunky and heavy but it makes up for it with great protection.

SunglassesHelm.name: Sunglasses
SunglassesHelm.description: Nothing is more important than sporting cool sunglasses, even when it's dark.

OctopusHelm.name: Omoroth's Helm
OctopusHelm.description: An iron-cast helm with a scary grimace and potruding tentacles.

KingSlimeCrown.name: King Slime Crown
KingSlimeCrown.description: A rare headpiece that crowns you as king of all slimes. You feel very royal wearing it.

GalaxiteHelm.name: Galaxite Helm
GalaxiteHelm.description: A futuristic helmet fit for a space explorer. Looking through its visor is like looking into the depths of the universe.

AssassinHelm.name: Assassin Hood
AssassinHelm.description: A mysterious hood for true desert dwellers that keeps the face in shade.

LavaHelm.name: Magma Horn Armor
LavaHelm.description: A pretty awesome piece of equipment that makes you look like the harbinger of doom.

ScarabHelm.name: Scarab Visor
ScarabHelm.description: A helm made in the design of Ra-Akar, casting its central eye on your enemies.

MinerHelm.name: Miner's Protective Helm
MinerHelm.description: A handy helm with integrated goggles and a still functioning headlamp.

DesertHelm.name: Paladin Mask
DesertHelm.description: A mysterious piece of equipment with a golden mask. It seems to have been granted to warriors of high rank.

PumpkinHelm.name: Pumpkin Head
PumpkinHelm.description: A fruit head with a carved-in face. For how disgusting it feels from the inside, it looks pretty cool on the outside.

GhostBlanketHelm.name: Spooky Blanket Hood
GhostBlanketHelm.description: A cheap last-minute attempt to get ready for the spooky season.

FrankensteinHelm.name: Frankenbrute Head
FrankensteinHelm.description: Put more head on your head. Doesn't necessarily add up to more brain, though.

GodsentHelm.name: Godsent King Mask
GodsentHelm.description: A unique, royal piece of armor resembling the head of the state, crowning it as a descendant of the gods. It was intended for a future that never came.

SkirmisherHelm.name: Skirmisher Cap
SkirmisherHelm.description: A headpiece worn by caveling skirmishers which has been cobbled together with larvaskin, leaves and dirty cloth.

SantaHelm.name: Festive Hat
SantaHelm.description: A warm, soft hat to keep ones ears warm in the cold season. You can't get around wearing one of those in winter.

GingerbreadManHelm.name: Gingerbreadman Head
GingerbreadManHelm.description: A funny headpiece made from gingerbread. Just ignore the creepy smile and soulless eyes.

GingerbreadHoodHelm.name: Gingerbread Hood
GingerbreadHoodHelm.description: This gingerbread headpiece has not been baked, so it remains flexible to be drawn over the head.

SnowmanHelm.name: Snowman Hat
SnowmanHelm.description: Whatever one is feeling at the moment, this hat covers it all up with a happy expression made from coal and carrots.

WeddingHelm.name: Flower Crown
WeddingHelm.description: A beautiful crown made from leaves and pink roses. It resembles a love that feels like eternal spring.

SuitHelm.name: Top Hat
SuitHelm.description: This hat is worn by everyone who considers themself an admirable adventurer equipped with a captivating charisma.

ArcheologyHelm.name: Explorer's Hat
ArcheologyHelm.description: A hat that's made to go adventuring. Never falls off, even when a giant boulder is chasing behind.

CookHelm.name: Chef's Hat
CookHelm.description: The hallmark of every professional cook. Proof that even in the undergrounds taste can have priority over nutrition.

RadicalRabbitEarsDiadem.name: Radical Rabbit Headband
RadicalRabbitEarsDiadem.description: A cute headband featuring white rabbit ears. You feel quite cheeky and swift wearing it.

TamerHelm.name: Wildwarden Mask
TamerHelm.description: A wooden mask with decorative leaves and horns attuned to the wildlife.

RangerHelm.name: Ranger Hood
RangerHelm.description: A dark hood of old cloth. Hardly anything but eyes set on your target peep through.

MushroomHelm.name: Shrooman Cap
MushroomHelm.description: It grows on your head. You can feel your wounds growing shut along with it.

PotHelm.name: Pot Lid
PotHelm.description: A heavy clay cover that has partially cracked and doubles down as a funny hat.

ShamanHelm.name: Shaman Skull
ShamanHelm.description: A skull covered in ritualistic markings. Its burning eye sockets ignite a fiery fury in you.

HiveBoneHelm.name: Hivebone Helm
HiveBoneHelm.description: A helm crowned with erratic fangs and thorns akin to those on the Hive Mother maw.

RamboHelm.name: Mercenary Headband
RamboHelm.description: The only thing you need to put on when you want to rush through the jungle as a one-man-army…wait, that was something else.

MoldwebHelm.name: Moldweb Helm
MoldwebHelm.description: A head-piece covered in living mold. Its pulse enhances your bodily functions.

PlagueDoctorHelm.name: Plague Mask
PlagueDoctorHelm.description: An eerie beaked mask. Its inside reeks of rancid death, yet lets you live to smell it.

CrystalHelm.name: Solarite Barbute
CrystalHelm.description: A nearly indestructible helm forged with patience and precision. When it is worn, you feel energized, lively and protected.

AtlantianWormHelm.name: Atlantean Worm Helmet
AtlantianWormHelm.description: A fierce looking helm that resembles the head of the Atlantean Worm. How it came to be is a mystery.

CookingPotHelm.name: Cooking Pot Lid
CookingPotHelm.description: A shiny metal cover that suppresses your boiling point.

AlienTechHelm.name: Cosmos Visor Helm
AlienTechHelm.description: A futuristic helm sealed under a big glass dome, leaving the view open to marvel at the miracles of space.

RadiationHelm.name: Hazmat Helm
RadiationHelm.description: Need to handle strange materials that emit even stranger radiation? Ask no more!

HydraBoneHelm.name: Hydra Bone Helm
HydraBoneHelm.description: The gruesome-looking empty skull of a hydra. One senses a malevolent presence when putting it on.

CoreCommanderHelm.name: Core Commander Helm
CoreCommanderHelm.description: The discarded headpiece of a high-rank armor. When worn, you can feel an immense power surging through your mind. It's whispering words you could never understand.

CorruptWardenHelm.name: Corrupt Warden Mask
CorruptWardenHelm.description: A wooden mask with decorative beads and a distant stare.

WitchDoctorHelm.name: Witch Doctor Hat
WitchDoctorHelm.description: A rustic top hat with various trinkets along the brim.

GrimHelm.name: Grim Hood
GrimHelm.description: This opposing hood is sure to strike fear into your opponents.

SorcererHelm.name: Sorcerer Hood
SorcererHelm.description: A hood worn by Initiated mages.

ArcaneMonkHelm.name: Arcane Monk Blindfold
ArcaneMonkHelm.description: The magic energies around you let you see just as clearly as with your eyes.

PandoriumHelm.name: Pandorium Helm
PandoriumHelm.description: Glistening and twisted. When worn, you feel attuned to all possible outcomes.

SulfurHelm.name: Sulfossil Helmet
SulfurHelm.description: Like a crown, when worn, you assert yourself dominant over the forces within this sulfuric mass.

ChieftainHelm.name: Chieftain Headdress
ChieftainHelm.description: This grand headdress shows clearly who's boss.

SoaringHelm.name: Soaring Headgear
SoaringHelm.description: A stylish hat and scarf, fit for one another.

DancerHelm.name: Tassel Earrings
DancerHelm.description: A pair of earrings, each with an elegant tassel decoration.

SwampMageHelm.name: Lily Pad Hat
SwampMageHelm.description: This lily pad appears unusually sturdy. It fits on your head nicely.

DesertGuardianHelm.name: Desert Guardian Mask
DesertGuardianHelm.description: A mysterious headpiece that resembles some sort of animal.

BlastHelm.name: Blast Helmet
BlastHelm.description: A heavy capsule that would be airtight if not for the narrow slits of its faceplate.

DreamerHelm.name: Dreamer Headband
DreamerHelm.description: A jade headband with hypnotically swaying fringes.

ShadowHelm.name: Shadow Helmet
ShadowHelm.description: A headgear that makes your mind feel void of emotion.

VoidFusedHelm.name: Void-Fused Helmet
VoidFusedHelm.description: A helmet brimming with dark pressure. You feel it could burst from the slightest crack.

InventorHelm.name: Inventor Goggles
InventorHelm.description: Goggles saturated with a maniacal green from one too many experimental mishaps.

PlateHelm.name: Welder Helmet
PlateHelm.description: A heat-resistant metal headpiece that protects the wearer from hazardous particles.

ScarfHelm.name: Scarf
ScarfHelm.description: A warm neckcloth for colder seasons.

BandanaHelm.name: Bandana
BandanaHelm.description: A rag fit for a suspenseful ruffian.

CopperBreastArmor.name: Copper Breastplate
CopperBreastArmor.description: Got no sixpack? Just craft one!

WoodBreastArmor.name: Wood Chest
WoodBreastArmor.description: Very crude armor for the upper body. Offers minor protection.

PeasantBreastArmor.name: Peasant Chest
PeasantBreastArmor.description: A simple makeshift armor for the upper body.

CavelingBreastArmor.name: Caveling Chest
CavelingBreastArmor.description: Made from grub leather, good for unhindered movement in combat.

IronBreastArmor.name: Iron Breastplate
IronBreastArmor.description: Charge into battle with this epic chest piece.

BronzeBreastArmor.name: Bronze Breastplate
BronzeBreastArmor.description: A good armor to survive battles more easily.

CarapaceBreastArmor.name: Carapace Breastplate
CarapaceBreastArmor.description: An organic body armor resembling Ghorm's shell, it is heavy and feels weird on the inside.

LarvaBreastArmor.name: Larva Chest
LarvaBreastArmor.description: Don't be anything else. Be grub.

ScarletBreastArmor.name: Scarlet Breastplate
ScarletBreastArmor.description: Fierce upper body armor for true warriors.

HunterBreastArmor.name: Hunter Cloak
HunterBreastArmor.description: A cloak crafted from big leaves woven together. Makes you look like a walking bush.

IvyBreastArmor.name: Ivy's Thorn Harness
IvyBreastArmor.description: This organic breastplate armor is crested with thorns, allowing for stronger critical hits.

OctarineBreastArmor.name: Octarine Breastplate
OctarineBreastArmor.description: This mysterious breastplate stimulates the muscles to swing your weapon much faster.

ScholarArmor.name: Scholar's Cloak
ScholarArmor.description: A magically-imbued piece of cloth, worn by caveling scholars. Wearing it you feel in tune with the ancients.

DiverArmor.name: Kelp Mantle
DiverArmor.description: An upper body armor made from long kelp strands. Now you feel like a real creature of the sea.

SlimeBreastArmor.name: Slime Armor
SlimeBreastArmor.description: A gelatinous upper body armor that looks like someone dumped a bucket of goo onto you.

TowelBreastArmor.name: Towel
