OstaraRing.description: A ring made of leaves and small golden eggs. It is a sign of emerging life and spring.

MorphaRing.name: Morpha's Ring
MorphaRing.description: A strange, little loop made from blue slime, it almost slides off of your finger.

CoralRing.name: Coral Ring
CoralRing.description: An intricate ring naturally grown from pink, branchy corals.

DiverRing.name: Goldfish Ring
DiverRing.description: A quite lively little ring that tries to swim off of your finger. By the time it realizes it's merely a ring it has already forgot about it again.

LuckyRing.name: Lucky Ring
LuckyRing.description: A cheaply made ring from a vending machine. If you believe hard enough you may feel more lucky.

AncientGuardianRing.name: Ancient Guardian Ring
AncientGuardianRing.description: A relic that is made in the same way as the Ancient Guardian Necklace, made for fending off the strongest of foes.

OmorothRing.name: Omoroth's Ring
OmorothRing.description: A plated looping tentacle that wraps around your finger. Stemming from a titan, it enhances your might in fighting these giant monsters.

OctarineRing.name: Octarine Ring
OctarineRing.description: A ring made from pure octarine enhanced with magic properties.

MagneticRing.name: Magnetic Ring
MagneticRing.description: A strange ring that pulls in loot around you in a higher radius. Magnets, how do they work?

GoldenSpikeRing.name: Golden Spike Ring
GoldenSpikeRing.description: This golden ring is very uncomfortable to wear but it looks really cool.

PolishedOctarineRing.name: Polished Octarine Ring
PolishedOctarineRing.description: A ring made from pure octarine enhanced with magic properties.

PolishedMagneticRing.name: Polished Magnetic Ring
PolishedMagneticRing.description: A strange ring that pulls in loot around you in a higher radius. Magnets, how do they work?

PolishedGoldenSpikeRing.name: Polished Golden Spike Ring
PolishedGoldenSpikeRing.description: This golden ring is very uncomfortable to wear but it looks really cool.

SpineRing.name: Spine Ring
SpineRing.description: A ring found at the skeleton of a giant ocean creature. It's made from tiny cervical vertebrae.

WoodenRing.name: Wooden Ring
WoodenRing.description: A simple wooden ring, nothing more, nothing less.

TopazRing.name: Topaz Ring
TopazRing.description: A precious little ring with a yellow gemstone on top.

WhiteGlassRing.name: White Glass Ring
WhiteGlassRing.description: This ring is made from a milky, translucent material. The light it reflects makes it harder for enemies to hit you.

SeptumRing.name: Septum Ring
SeptumRing.description: A golden piece of jewelry that's not put onto the finger but rather on the nose.

RingOfSand.name: Ring of Sand
RingOfSand.description: A strange ring made from sand that is held together by the currents of time.

BoneRing.name: Bone Ring
BoneRing.description: A prehistoric, crude ring made from bone. Rings like these have been discovered in early human graves.

NomadRing.name: Nomad Ring
NomadRing.description: This small finger band is made from ragged cloth to keep it from heating up in the scorching desert valleys.

BlackRing.name: Black Ring
BlackRing.description: A ring made from pitch-black metal, darkened by the constant presence of immense heat.

FlameRing.name: Flame Ring
FlameRing.description: This strange ring produces a flame that affects anything but its wearer.

BombRing.name: Bomb Ring
BombRing.description: A ring crowned with a little bomb idol. Handling explosives while wearing it results in an even stronger blast.

NobleRing.name: Noble Ring
NobleRing.description: An expensive looking ring featuring a ruby. It must have belonged to someone wealthy.

DoubleRing.name: Double Ring
DoubleRing.description: This ring is made to be put on two fingers at the same time. Revolutionary.

SamhainCurseRing.name: Samhain Curse Ring
SamhainCurseRing.description: A cursed ring that was used to welcome the cold season into the lands. It represents decay and darkness.

ValentineRing.name: Valentine Ring
ValentineRing.description: A golden ring featuring a candy-colored heart. The perfect gift to give to someone you like.

TamerRing.name: Wildwarden Ring
TamerRing.description: A wooden ring with two smaller rings around it. One symbolizes the warden and the other the bonded beast.

CopperSword.name: Copper Sword
CopperSword.description: A good weapon for slaying foes.

IronSword.name: Iron Sword
IronSword.description: A strong weapon for slaying foes.

ScarletSword.name: Scarlet Sword
ScarletSword.description: A great weapon for slaying foes.

TinSword.name: Tin Sword
TinSword.description: A sharp weapon for slaying foes.

SlimeSword.name: Slime Sword
SlimeSword.description: A strange weapon, good for damaging enemies and slowing them down.

OctarineSword.name: Octarine Sword
OctarineSword.description: An extraordinary weapon for slaying foes.

SlipperySlimeSword.name: Slippery Slime Sword
SlipperySlimeSword.description: A blue variant of the slime sword. It sometimes spreads slime onto your enemies that makes them slide around.

GalaxiteSword.name: Galaxite Sword
GalaxiteSword.description: An otherworldly weapon for slaying foes.

WoodSword.name: Wooden Sword
WoodSword.description: A crude weapon to fend off foes.

SolariteSword.name: Solarite Sword
SolariteSword.description: A superior weapon for obliterating foes.

AtlantianWormSword.name: Atlantean Worm Sword
AtlantianWormSword.description: A dislodged, razorsharp mandible of the Atlantean Worm. The maker of the deep sea.

LarvaSpikeClub.name: Larva Spike Club
LarvaSpikeClub.description: A bludgeoning weapon that is hard to withstand.

ShardClub.name: Crystal Shard Club
ShardClub.description: This bludgeoning weapon is made from fragile crystal, that can send out splinters when swung.

PoisonousSickle.name: Poisonous Sickle
PoisonousSickle.description: Farming tool that turned into a weapon when a great threat had to be slain.

BrokenLegendarySword.name: Broken Handle
BrokenLegendarySword.description: A piece of an ancient weapon. Even though it's only the handle it already feels mysteriously balanced in your hand.

LegendarySword.name: Rune Song
LegendarySword.description: A legendary sword that hums when swung through the air. Its durability is a testament to extraordinary craftsmanship, said to carry the whispers of ancient battles within its blade.

TinDagger.name: Tin Dagger
TinDagger.description: A small blade that allows for quick stabs.

TinAxe.name: Tin Axe
TinAxe.description: A slower but more damaging weapon against multiple enemies.

BattleAxe.name: Battle Axe
BattleAxe.description: A menacing weapon that swings wide and hits hard.

ScarletDagger.name: Scarlet Dagger
ScarletDagger.description: This wavy, crimson dagger pierces through most materials.

RitualDagger.name: Ritual Dagger
RitualDagger.description: This unusual dagger is made from a big gemstone shard. There are dark red spots on the handle.

OctarineAxe.name: Octarine Axe
OctarineAxe.description: This crescent-shaped weapon hits hard and magically arcs towards enemies' weak spots.

AnchorAxe.name: Anchor Axe
AnchorAxe.description: This heavy weapon is actually just a ship anchor. Hits very hard and can throw enemies off.

LavaAxe.name: Lava Battle Axe
LavaAxe.description: A smoldering, heavy weapon that looks like it was just taken out of the forge.

GalaxiteDagger.name: Galaxite Dagger
GalaxiteDagger.description: A quick-stabbing weapon made for close combat. The blade is so fine that it can cut a hair into two pieces lengthways.

RustyDagger.name: Rusty Dagger
RustyDagger.description: A blade so corroded it only vaguely resembles copper. It's deceptively sharp.

TentacleWhip.name: Tentacle Whip
TentacleWhip.description: An elastic tentacle that lashes out at enemies from afar. It's still alive and wiggling in your hand.

HuntingSpear.name: Hunting Spear
HuntingSpear.description: A very crude long-reach weapon used by the cavelings dwelling in the Clay Caves. Good to hunt larvae and place them over a fire.

AncientSpear.name: Prehistoric Crystal Spear
AncientSpear.description: One of the first weapons ever made by mankind, but this one has an ancient gemstone in place of a normal spearhead.

IronHalberdSpear.name: Iron Halberd
IronHalberdSpear.description: A luxurious pole-weapon fit for a royal guardian and perfect for poking at adversaries.

HydraBoneSword.name: Hydra Bone Sword
HydraBoneSword.description: A jagged sword made from a hydra's spine. It is not particularly sharp but its uneven shape can tear dangerous wounds into your opponents.

PandoriumAxe.name: Pandorium Axe
PandoriumAxe.description: This weapon has been designed by minds twisted in the darkness of The Passage. It tears more than it cuts.

VoidClub.name: Void Club
VoidClub.description: This club feels light when held, yet heavy when swung.

Bomb.name: Bomb
Bomb.description: A stronger explosive for crowd control and facing giant enemies.

SmallBomb.name: Crude Bomb
SmallBomb.description: A small explosive to blast walls and enemies.

LargeBomb.name: Large Bomb
LargeBomb.description: A very strong explosive for massive destruction.

FireworkRed.name: Red Firework Rocket
FireworkRed.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a red explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

FireworkGreen.name: Green Firework Rocket
FireworkGreen.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a green explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

FireworkBlue.name: Blue Firework Rocket
FireworkBlue.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a blue explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

FireworkYellow.name: Yellow Firework Rocket
FireworkYellow.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a yellow explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

FireworkPurple.name: Purple Firework Rocket
FireworkPurple.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a purple explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

FireworkBig.name: The BIG
FireworkBig.description: This giant firework rocket needs some time to take off but rewards patience with a spectacular explosion. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

SulfurBomb.name: Sulfur Bomb
SulfurBomb.description: A large bomb harnessing the power of pressurized toxic gas.

FireGrenade.name: Fire Grenade
FireGrenade.description: An explosive fit for those who want to set the world on fire!

PoisonGrenade.name: Poison Grenade
PoisonGrenade.description: An explosive that is hard to recover from.

Grenade.name: Grenade
Grenade.description: A throwable explosive that bounces on impact.

StunGrenade.name: Stun Grenade
StunGrenade.description: Creates a blast that overwhelms the senses.

CharmGrenade.name: Charm Grenade
CharmGrenade.description: Nothing is as persuasive as a little explosive charm.

SeekerBomb.name: Mouse Bomb
SeekerBomb.description: A forward moving explosive that explodes on impact.

BlunderBomb.name: Blunder Bomb
BlunderBomb.description: Triggers a directional sequence of explosions, perfect for clearing a path.

VoidBomb.name: Void Bomb
VoidBomb.description: Draws in nearby enemies before spitting them out in pieces.

ProximityBomb.name: Proximity Bomb
ProximityBomb.description: An explosive that is triggered when an enemy steps near.

OilGrenade.name: Oil Grenade
OilGrenade.description: Splatters combustible oil all over the ground.

BigGrenade.name: Blast Bundle
BigGrenade.description: Thrown much like a regular grenade... but creates a stronger blast!

FlintlockMusket.name: Flintlock Musket
FlintlockMusket.description: Can't argue much with a handful of lead coming right at you.

Slingshot.name: Slingshot
Slingshot.description: Simple ranged weapon to fire away at enemies.

Grubzooka.name: Grubzooka
Grubzooka.description: The heavy shots from the Grubzooka also tear down any dirt, sand and turf walls in its path.

HandMortar.name: Scrapzooka
HandMortar.description: A weapon of scrap. Because some problems are best blasted away.

Blowpipe.name: Blowpipe
Blowpipe.description: A simple weapon loaded with poisonous darts.

FireballStaff.name: Fireball Staff
FireballStaff.description: A magical staff that the caveling shamans use in their rituals and against uninvited guests.

OctarineBow.name: Octarine Bow
OctarineBow.description: A strange bow that enhances the way arrows fly, allowing for quicker shots.

LegendaryBow.name: Phantom Spark
LegendaryBow.description: A legendary, masterfully crafted bow that shoots pure energy projectiles. Sometimes those pierce the veil of time and space, calling upon the spirits of the past.

IronBow.name: Iron Bow
IronBow.description: A sturdy bow to shoot foes from afar.

WoodBow.name: Wood Bow
WoodBow.description: A crude bow to shoot foes from afar.

ScholarStaff.name: Scholar's Staff
ScholarStaff.description: A magical staff wielded by caveling scholars that utilizes an ancient gemstone to produce powerful bolts of energy.

BubbleGun.name: Bubble Gun
BubbleGun.description: A strange ranged weapon that shoots out hovering bubbles, adding slippery movement on contact.

ThrowingDaggers.name: Throwing Daggers
ThrowingDaggers.description: A set of curved blades. They're evenly balanced so that throwing them is as easy as pointing a finger.

GalaxiteChakram.name: Galaxite Chakram
GalaxiteChakram.description: This unique throwing weapon requires finesse and dexterity to be used to its full potential.

Burnzooka.name: Burnzooka
Burnzooka.description: This fiery weapon was modeled after the grubzooka but enhanced with lava rock shielding to contain its power. Can blast away stone walls and anything weaker.

ScarabMortar.name: Bomb Scarab Mortar
ScarabMortar.description: A powerful weapon launching explosive projectiles that resemble the center eye of a bomb scarab.

Snowball.name: Snowball
Snowball.description: A handy projectile to start some fights with the neighbours' children. Can also be collected and further processed.

CupidBow.name: Cupid Bow
CupidBow.description: A bow that hits right into the heart of its target and has a chance to infatuate it with the archer.

SlimeStaff.name: Sticky Stick
SlimeStaff.description: This staff is drenched in slime that never seems to end no matter how much is flung away.

WoodCrossbow.name: Wood Crossbow
WoodCrossbow.description: A small wooden crossbow that swiftly shoots bolts.

ScarletCrossbow.name: Scarlet Crossbow
ScarletCrossbow.description: A heavy metallic crossbow that shoots potent bolts.

SolariteCrossbow.name: Solarite Crossbow
SolariteCrossbow.description: A grand glimmering crossbow that shoots mighty bolts.

RazorFlake.name: Ricochet Shuriken
RazorFlake.description: A four-bladed throwing weapon that bounces back and forth across the room. Slicing any enemy in its path.

VoidOrbGun.name: Void Gun
VoidOrbGun.description: A particle weapon with unknown inner workings. It emits balls of void that distort spacetime to inflict high damage.

LightningGun.name: Stormbringer
LightningGun.description: Augmented by a mysterious energy, this weapon unleashes chaining arcs of lightning upon your foes. Holding it sends a tingling sensation through your arms.

ChaosStaff.name: Chaos Staff
ChaosStaff.description: An unpredictable, powerful weapon that weaves chaotic ancient energy into all kinds of projectiles. The enemy will never know what's coming for them.

Minigun.name: Scrap Minigun
Minigun.description: A gun-like apparatus that manages to convert disposable debris into a flurry of cutting missiles.

Flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
Flamethrower.description: A bulky tank attached to a hose spraying ignited fuel, ready to set the world ablaze.

LegendaryMortar.name: Credence of Ruin
LegendaryMortar.description: A relic born of cult devotion and void corruption. Forged from S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s own frame and sanctified components of Breaker's Reach.

LavaMortar.name: Volcano Mortar
LavaMortar.description: Erupts molten chunks into the air to crash like meteoroids.

StoneMortar.name: Stone Mortar
StoneMortar.description: A handheld cannon hurling rocks into the air. They won't know what hit 'em!

ArcaneStaff.name: Arcane Staff
ArcaneStaff.description: Unleash a torrent of arcane energies.

ZealotSword.name: Zealot's Scimitar
ZealotSword.description: A brilliant sword that channels mana into the blade to increase its power.

SunStaff.name: Sun Caller
SunStaff.description: Used by great mages to conjure small stars.

MeteorStaff.name: Corrupted Meteor Staff
MeteorStaff.description: A weathered staff infused with cosmic corruption. It crackles with unfathomable energies and whispers of forbidden power.

MeteorStaffLesser.name: Noxious Meteor Staff
MeteorStaffLesser.description: A tainted staff laced with corroding blight. It sizzles with embittered energies that rain down a dense drop of toxin.

LegendaryStaff.name: Titan Breath
LegendaryStaff.description: Wrought by restrained paradox, it inhales energy to exhale a controlled cut through the aether. Anything trapped within is overwhelmed by the distilled entropy.

TomeOfRange.name: Tome of the Dark
TomeOfRange.description: More of a pamphlet, beginners guide to shadowmancy.

TomeOfOrbit.name: Tome of the Deep
TomeOfOrbit.description: A tome that contains powerful incantions barely utterable by the human tongue.

TomeOfMelee.name: Tome of the Dead
TomeOfMelee.description: A vile treatise on the conjuring of restless spirits.

TomeOfFire.name: Tome of Ashes
TomeOfFire.description: Reeks of sulfur and is hot to the touch.

TomeOfPoison.name: Tome of Sprouts
TomeOfPoison.description: A mystical tome germinating with verdant potential.

TomeOfRadiation.name: Tome of Decay
TomeOfRadiation.description: Flipping through its pages causes your fingers to go numb.

TomeOfMining.name: Tome of Breach
TomeOfMining.description: More of an unfinished journal detailing the author's obsession with unearthing secrets.

HealingPotion.name: Healing Potion
HealingPotion.description: A healthy elixir that heals instantly. Also tastes good.

EnragePotion.name: Enrage Potion
EnragePotion.description: A strong elixir that buffs your muscles and your temper.

StoneskinPotion.name: Stoneskin Potion
StoneskinPotion.description: A salty elixir that hardens your skin and makes you more resilient.

PoisonAidPotion.name: Poison Aid Potion
PoisonAidPotion.description: A purple, mucky liquid that tastes horrible but cures any poison.

GreaterHealingPotion.name: Greater Healing Potion
GreaterHealingPotion.description: A much healthier elixir that heals instantly. Also tastes great.

KeenPotion.name: Keen Potion
KeenPotion.description: A cold elixir that focuses your senses and aim.

GuardiansPotion.name: Guardian's Potion
GuardiansPotion.description: A potion that fills you with great courage and the ability to withstand the strongest of foes.

CavelingCoffee.name: Cave Coffee
CavelingCoffee.description: A strong, bottled brew made from unknown ingredients. After ingesting it's hard for you to stand still.

HeartberrySoda.name: Heart Berry Soda
HeartberrySoda.description: This canned sparkly drink is a pure explosion of taste and sweetness in your mouth.

CrystalWater.name: Crystal Water
CrystalWater.description: Crystal clear water that has been filtered through ancient gemstones.

UnusualPotion.name: Unusual Potion
UnusualPotion.description: A two-component potion that is risky to drink.

LiquidMetal.name: Splendid Amalgam
LiquidMetal.description: A boiling-hot metallic fluid that merges with the bodies' cells after consumption, making them more resilient.

MagicPotion.name: Arcane Potion
MagicPotion.description: A volatile concoction that amplifies your magical energy.

MinionPotion.name: Pact of Power Potion
MinionPotion.description: An ominous looking liquid that elevates the power of your summoned forces.

GiantMitochondrion.name: Giant Mitochondrion
GiantMitochondrion.description: This supersized organelle is a real powerhouse.

BurnResistancePotion.name: Burn Resistance Potion
BurnResistancePotion.description: Dousing yourself with this elixir makes you flame retardant. Fire may still hurt, but it won't linger.

ManaPotion.name: Mana Potion
ManaPotion.description: A potent elixir that instantly refills your inner power. Also tastes sweet.

GreaterManaPotion.name: Greater Mana Potion
GreaterManaPotion.description: A very potent elixir that instantly refills your inner power. Also tastes syrupy.

CavelingBread.name: Caveling Bread
CavelingBread.description: Dry, hard bread. It feels like chewing chalk but fills the stomach.

JingleJamCookie.name: Jingle Jam Cookie
JingleJamCookie.description: A special gift for participating in the Jingle Jam charity event.

FoodRation.name: Food Ration
FoodRation.description: Canned meal made to last for years. You should look for better food options soon.

CavelingCrunch.name: Cave Crunch
CavelingCrunch.description: A chunky, sweet snack in a wrapper. Must be thousands of years old and probably still edible for a couple more.

GlazedHeartberry.name: Glazed Heart Berry
GlazedHeartberry.description: A sugar-covered heart berry that's still juicy and fresh underneath. Delicious!

TentacleJerky.name: Tentacle Jerky
TentacleJerky.description: A dried piece of tentacle. It's quite tough and keeps your teeth busy.

ChewyConeCandy.name: Chewy Cone Candy
ChewyConeCandy.description: A super sweet candy that ends up in the gap of your teeth. And it's there to stay.

SpookyPopCandy.name: Spooky Pop Candy
SpookyPopCandy.description: It looks almost too scary to remove its wrapper. What tasty horrors might await behind?

EvilEyeCandy.name: Evil Eye Candy
EvilEyeCandy.description: The most wicked creation of all, its taste an insult to the living. Black licorice.

FruitBread.name: Fruit Bread
FruitBread.description: A traditionally baked fruit bread with powdered sugar on top. One slice is never enough!

WinterDinner.name: Winter Dinner
WinterDinner.description: A full meal to warm your belly in the cold season. Prepared with a roasted larva, hot heartberry sauce, dumplings and some greens.

HotPunch.name: Hot Punch
HotPunch.description: Sitting down with this nice beverage will send a shiver of cozyness down ones spine. It's spicy, fruity and simply tasty.

HotChocolate.name: Hot Chocolate
HotChocolate.description: A mug full of creamy, hot chocolate milk with small marshmallows on top. Drinking it feels like being a kid again.

WinterCookies.name: Winter Cookies
WinterCookies.description: Nicely decorated this handful of cookies will put one in a seasonal mood. There's even a little core-shaped one in there.

GoldenChocolate.name: Golden Chocolate
GoldenChocolate.description: A limited edition chocolate for the cold season. There is no golden ticket inside, instead the whole thing is made out of it!

BoxOfChocolates.name: Box of Chocolates
BoxOfChocolates.description: These chocolates come in a nice gift box and are mouth and heart melting.

DistilledSlime.name: Distilled Love
DistilledSlime.description: This beverage made from rare pink slime tastes like cotton sugar and makes your heart flutter.

KelpDumpling.name: Kelp Dumpling
KelpDumpling.description: A soft, warm dumpling that smells pretty... funny. You don't really want to know where that one came from.

AtlantianWormHeart.name: Atlantean Worm Heart
AtlantianWormHeart.description: This is but one of the many hundred hearts of the Atlantean Worm that give it the strength to hurl its gigantic body through the water. Therefore it brims with vitality that you can now call your own.

CrystalKelp.name: Crystal Kelp
CrystalKelp.description: A crystallized lump of marine plants.

CosmicCheese.name: Lunar Cheese
CosmicCheese.description: An aromatic snack that seems out of this world. Is it proof that the moon is made out of cheese after all?

FruitBasket.name: Paradise Fruit Basket
FruitBasket.description: A pure explosion of flavors enters your mouth when biting into these fruits.

VoidHydraHeart.name: Oblidra's Heart
VoidHydraHeart.description: This still beating heart of the Void Lord pulses inward rather than outward. It brims with vitality that you can now call your own.

OrangeCaveGuppy.name: Orange Cave Guppy
OrangeCaveGuppy.description: Small, orange fish home to the dirt cave lakes.

BlueCaveGuppy.name: Blue Cave Guppy
BlueCaveGuppy.description: Small, blue fish home to the dirt cave lakes.

RockJaw.name: Rock Jaw
RockJaw.description: A small shark that can break almost every material with one bite.

GemCrab.name: Gem Crab
GemCrab.description: This rare crab has ancient gemstones growing all over it.

DaggerFin.name: Dagger Fin
DaggerFin.description: The scales of this fish are thin like razorblades.

PinkPalaceFish.name: Pink Palace Fish
PinkPalaceFish.description: A pink, odd-looking fish with weirdly shaped fins.

TealPalaceFish.name: Teal Palace Fish
TealPalaceFish.description: A greenish-blue, odd-looking fish with weirdly shaped fins.

CrownSquid.name: Crown Squid
CrownSquid.description: All hail the pale king of water!

YellowBlisterHead.name: Yellow Blister Head
YellowBlisterHead.description: A fish with large yellow bubbles on its head.

GreenBlisterHead.name: Green Blister Head
GreenBlisterHead.description: A fish with large green bubbles on its head.

DevilWorm.name: Devil Worm
DevilWorm.description: A hellspawn that dwells in the sea ground. Don't step on it.

VampireEel.name: Vampire Eel
VampireEel.description: A bloodsucking fish latching onto everything that has a pulse.

MoldShark.name: Mold Shark
MoldShark.description: A small predator of the murky mold waters.

RotFish.name: Rot Fish
RotFish.description: Half of its body is missing but somehow it's still alive. Creepy.

BlackSteelUrchin.name: Black Steel Urchin
BlackSteelUrchin.description: A rare sea critter with spikes as hard as steel.

AzureFeatherFish.name: Azure Feather Fish
AzureFeatherFish.description: A beautiful blue fish with scales that look like feathers.

EmeraldFeatherFish.name: Emerald Feather Fish
EmeraldFeatherFish.description: A beautiful green fish with scales that look like feathers.

SpiritVeil.name: Spirit Veil
SpiritVeil.description: A ghastly fish that floats in the air like it's still underwater.

AstralJelly.name: Astral Jelly
AstralJelly.description: Extremely rare type of jellyfish. It almost feels out of this world.

BottomTracer.name: Bottom Tracer
BottomTracer.description: A bright yellow fish with long barbels that it drags along the sea floor in search for food.

SilverTorrentDart.name: Silver Dart
SilverTorrentDart.description: This elusive fish appears in swarms as a spectacle of blinking silver to confuse predators.

GoldenTorrentDart.name: Golden Dart
GoldenTorrentDart.description: This elusive fish appears in swarms as a spectacle of flickering gold to confuse predators.

PinkCoralotl.name: Pink Coralotl
PinkCoralotl.description: A small pink amphibian with outward-protruding gills that look like corals. It also uses them to draw nutrients out of the waters of the Sunken Sea.

WhiteCoralotl.name: White Coralotl
WhiteCoralotl.description: A small white amphibian with outward-protruding gills that look like corals. It also uses them to draw nutrients out of the waters of the Sunken Sea.

SolidSpikeback.name: Solid Spikeback
SolidSpikeback.description: A very defensive fish with rock-hard skin and sharp spikes protruding out.

SandySpikeback.name: Sandy Spikeback
SandySpikeback.description: A very defensive fish with sandstone skin and jagged spikes protruding out.

GreyDuneTail.name: Gray Dune Tail
GreyDuneTail.description: This gray, agile fish is able to move between water holes in the desert to change feeding grounds.

BrownDuneTail.name: Brown Dune Tail
BrownDuneTail.description: This brown, agile fish is able to move between water holes in the desert to change feeding grounds.

TornisKingfish.name: Tornis Kingfish
TornisKingfish.description: An extremely rare enigma of sea life that seems to unify all other fish beneath it.

DarkLavaEater.name: Dark Lava Eater
DarkLavaEater.description: A dark fish with fiery belly that seems to purely feed from liquid stone and the gemstones caught within.

BrightLavaEater.name: Bright Lava Eater
BrightLavaEater.description: A bright fish with fiery belly that seems to purely feed from liquid stone and the gemstones caught within.

VerdantDragonfish.name: Verdant Dragonfish
VerdantDragonfish.description: This draconic fish has green scales that can withstand remarkably high temperatures.

ElderDragonfish.name: Elder Dragonfish
ElderDragonfish.description: A draconic fish that is several hundred years old. The verdant color of its scales has long faded.

StarlightNautilus.name: Starlight Nautilus
StarlightNautilus.description: A mysterious living fossil that seems to have fused with precious metals and gemstones to ascend to a higher state of being.

AngleFish.name: Beryll Angle Fish
AngleFish.description: This moon-blue fish seemed to have had a normal body once, but the water of the Shimmering Frontier corrupted it to be crystalline through and through.

Deepstalker.name: Glistening Deepstalker
Deepstalker.description: A crystal-plated predator that slithers through the glowing waters of the Shimmering Frontier, always on the hunt for something weaker.

CosmicForm.name: Cosmic Form
CosmicForm.description: A strange entity that is unlike any terrestrial sea life you have ever seen. Did it come from a place far away from earth?

GoldenAngleFish.name: Jasper Angle Fish
GoldenAngleFish.description: This sun-golden fish seemed to have had a normal body once, but the water of the Shimmering Frontier corrupted it to be crystalline through and through.

GoldenDeepstalker.name: Splendid Deepstalker
GoldenDeepstalker.description: A Solarite-plated predator that slithers through the glowing waters of the Shimmering Frontier, always on the hunt for something weaker.

TerraTrilobite.name: Terra Trilobite
TerraTrilobite.description: The mutated offspring of its extinct ancestor. Its brown shell had adapted to withstand extreme pressure.

LithoTrilobite.name: Litho Trilobite
LithoTrilobite.description: The mutated offspring of its extinct ancestor. Its gray shell had adapted to withstand extreme pressure.

PinkhornPico.name: Pinkhorn Pico
PinkhornPico.description: This little pink creature is entirely translucent with no visible brain. It seems unbothered being held.

GreenhornPico.name: Greenhorn Pico
GreenhornPico.description: This little green creature is entirely translucent with no visible brain. It seems unbothered being held.

RiftianLampfish.name: Riftian Lampfish
RiftianLampfish.description: An extraordinary creature that doesn't seem to be from this world. Its biology works entirely different from anything you know.

CritterBeetle.name: Blackbug
CritterBeetle.description: This tiny bug appears in many different places. Right now it's looking for a new home.

CritterLarva.name: Larvlet
CritterLarva.description: A tiny larva that doesn't harm you but likes to be collected and held in a warm hand.

CritterCrab.name: Moon Pincher
CritterCrab.description: This blue-purple crustacean always has its claws raised which gives it a seemingly happy expression.

ButterflySunset.name: Dusk Fairy
ButterflySunset.description: A tiny butterfly with very delicate wings. Catching it without harming them requires a lot of caution.

ButterflyDreamy.name: Dream Messenger
ButterflyDreamy.description: Said to be a bringer of good dreams this butterfly is always seen among sleeping creatures.

ButterflyCitrus.name: Citrus Pinion
ButterflyCitrus.description: An erraticly fluttering butterfly that has bright colors irritating to the naked eye.

ButterflyIcy.name: Ice Wind
ButterflyIcy.description: This blue butterfly flaps its wings so fast that it creates cold air streams.

ButterflyBase.name: Crimson Wing
ButterflyBase.description: A small butterfly with deep red wings that seeks the company of other critters.

CritterScorpion.name: Little Death
CritterScorpion.description: This small scorpion is harmless to humans but can easily kill smaller creatures if it needs food.

CritterGrasshopper.name: Leafhopper
CritterGrasshopper.description: A very nervous little fellow. The faintest hint of danger makes it jump away into safety.

CritterWorm.name: Earthworm
CritterWorm.description: A worm. Nothing special about it.

CritterCentipede.name: Manyleg
CritterCentipede.description: This desert critter has an unknown amount of legs. It would simply take too long to count them.

CritterCockroach.name: Pest Bug
CritterCockroach.description: A disgusting insect that moves with uncanny speed. It commonly is found in places that have darkness, dirt and food to offer.

CritterCrab2.name: Sun Pincher
CritterCrab2.description: This red-yellow crustacean always has its claws raised which gives it a seemingly happy expression.

CritterTinySnail.name: Gem Snail
CritterTinySnail.description: A small snail that slowly works its way through the dangers of the Shimmering Frontier.

CritterSnootFly.name: Snoot Fly
CritterSnootFly.description: Frantically flying around, this little mosquito pokes at other lifeforms for a potential drop of blood.

CritterNewt.name: Shadow Newt
CritterNewt.description: A dark fellow with seemingly unseeing eyes. But they stare deep into your soul.

CritterPassageFly.name: Drape Ray
CritterPassageFly.description: This luminous dweller drifts through the air like a calm breath, even in the most impetuous areas.

CritterShrew.name: Sniffling
CritterShrew.description: This skittish little rodent scurries around for hardened crumbs left in debris.

CritterLarvaVoid.name: Void Larvlet
CritterLarvaVoid.description: A tiny void larva that doesn't harm you but likes to be collected and held in a warm hand.

LegendarySwordBlade.name: Chipped Blade
LegendarySwordBlade.description: A piece of an ancient weapon. Its glass-like appearance makes it look fragile but it's harder than any material you've seen.

LegendarySwordGemstone.name: Clear Gemstone
LegendarySwordGemstone.description: A piece of an ancient weapon. Even though it is of the same material as ancient gemstones, this one feels unnaturally clear and infused with a strange energy.

ShamanBossCrystalShard.name: Crystal Skull Shard
ShamanBossCrystalShard.description: An ancient crystal shard that is only the fraction of something bigger.

CoreProtocol1.name: Shutdown Protocol
CoreProtocol1.description: This blue slate depicts a graph of a sudden spike in energy levels before collapsing.

CoreProtocol2.name: Anomaly Report
CoreProtocol2.description: This blue slate depicts a graph of a disturbance in previous patterns resulting in more advanced processes.

CoreProtocol3.name: Overwrite Transcript
CoreProtocol3.description: This blue slate depicts a graph of an entity redistributing processing power from multiple sources.

LegendaryBowPart1.name: Channeling Gemstone
LegendaryBowPart1.description: A specially carved ancient gemstone that focuses energy at its tip. It seems to be the center piece of an ancient powerful weapon.

LegendaryBowPart2.name: Fractured Limbs
LegendaryBowPart2.description: Golden pieces that once seemed to be fused together to endure great pressure. Something inherently powerful must have broken them apart.

LegendaryBowPart3.name: Energy String
LegendaryBowPart3.description: A fine filament that has microscopic pieces of ancient gemstones woven into it. Its existence is proof of the absolute mastery over materials by whoever created it.

CrystalMeteorShard.name: Crystal Meteor Shard
CrystalMeteorShard.description: This piece is merely a fraction of an enormous ancient gemstone.

HydraBossFirstCraftingItem.name: Giant Bug Brain
HydraBossFirstCraftingItem.description: The main sensory organ of Ra-Akar. It has evolved to detect disturbances deep in the ground and might become useful later.

HydraBossNatureCraftingItem.name: Pink Hydra Eye
HydraBossNatureCraftingItem.description: One of the three eyes of Druidra. It has a deep connection to other hydra entities and plays a key role in attracting them.

HydraBossSeaCraftingItem.name: White Hydra Eye
HydraBossSeaCraftingItem.description: One of the three eyes of Crydra. It has a deep connection to other hydra entities and plays a key role in attracting them.

HydraBossVoidCraftingItem.name: Oblivion Fragment
HydraBossVoidCraftingItem.description: A piece of obliterated antimatter. It has a deep connection to entities living in negative space and plays a key role in attracting one.

LegendaryMortarPart1.name: Void-Forged Barrel
LegendaryMortarPart1.description: A fractured artillery tube, scavenged from the cult's excavation machines. Its surface is warped by void corrosion. Clearly meant to complete a larger design.

LegendaryMortarPart2.name: Sanctified Firing Core
LegendaryMortarPart2.description: An ignition device made from gemstone, once used by Sahabar's exiles to fuse prayer and machinery. Even dormant, it radiates the strange conviction of those who believed metal could carry faith. It seems built to align with something greater.

LegendaryMortarPart3.name: S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s Mortar Housing
LegendaryMortarPart3.description: The shattered launcher torn from S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s frame. A faint inscription on the housing reads "Sanctified Artificial Herald Against Breach And Ruin". Its rails still hold lingering heat.

LegendaryStaffPart1.name: Coiled Branch
LegendaryStaffPart1.description: Its twigs curl around anything it touches with a firm grip. It could surely bind together the most volatile of pieces.

LegendaryStaffPart2.name: Magma Rod
LegendaryStaffPart2.description: Perpetually hot to the touch, cast in a highly arcana-inductive alloy. It would amplify great power if cooled enough to be properly wielded.

LegendaryStaffPart3.name: Frozen Orb
LegendaryStaffPart3.description: Cold to the touch, yet never melting. The light within seems ready to wreak havoc if warmed just enough to escape its frigid prison.

EasterEggDirt.name: Brown Easter Egg
EasterEggDirt.description: A dirty collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

EasterEggClay.name: Rose Easter Egg
EasterEggClay.description: An icky collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

EasterEggStone.name: Gray Easter Egg
EasterEggStone.description: A rocky collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

EasterEggNature.name: Green Easter Egg
EasterEggNature.description: A weedy collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

EasterGoldenEgg.name: Large Golden Egg
EasterGoldenEgg.description: A golden crystalline egg. It might be used for something more than just decoration...

EasterChickenHat.name: Chicken Hat
EasterChickenHat.description: A derpy-looking chicken hat that will be center of attention at the next party. Clucking funny!

EasterChickenSuit.name: Chicken Breast Piece
EasterChickenSuit.description: Itchy feathers and a concerning lack of ventilation make this chicken body piece a bold choice of clothing.

EasterChickenPants.name: Chicken Pants
EasterChickenPants.description: These flashy pants are chicken skin-inducing and complete the look of an egg-citing easter costume.

EasterEggcellentHat.name: Eggcellent Hat
EasterEggcellentHat.description: Everyone wearing this oversized egg shell hat has only one mission: to become egg.

EasterEggcellentSuit.name: Eggcellent Breast Piece
EasterEggcellentSuit.description: A spacious, oval shape that is made from hopes, dreams and lime. In other words: Egg.

EasterEggcellentPants.name: Eggcellent Pants
EasterEggcellentPants.description: These cheaply made pants are as yellow as egg yolk and itchy beyond comprehension.

EasterPillar.name: Easter Pillar
EasterPillar.description: A beautiful decorative pillar, holding up high a planter containing spring flowers. A perfect way to greet the new season.

EasterEggFlowerpot.name: Easter Egg Flowerpot
EasterEggFlowerpot.description: Greenery and daisies pop out of this egg-shaped flowerpot. They resemble the awakening of spring.

EasterDaisyFloorspread.name: Daisy Flooring
EasterDaisyFloorspread.description: A handful of daisies, made to sprinkle some spring onto the floor. One package is enough to cover a 1x1 ground tile.

EasterGarland.name: Easter Garland
EasterGarland.description: This charming green garland is adorned with little daisies, making it a perfect addition to your Easter-themed walls.

EasterMeadowTable.name: Easter Meadow Table
EasterMeadowTable.description: Lay out your belongings on this soft, overgrown table that fits every nature-themed base.

EasterEggLamp.name: Easter Egg Lamp
EasterEggLamp.description: Illuminate your base with this decorative lamp, featuring a golden easter egg sitting in a nest of greenery.

EasterMeadowStool.name: Easter Meadow Stool
EasterMeadowStool.description: Sitting on this stool feels as if sitting on a freshly cut meadow. There is no better spot to place ones bottoms.

EasterPedestal.name: Easter Pedestal
EasterPedestal.description: A small 1x1 table made from creme-colored stone and a little leaf as cover. Simple, practical and still in line with the Easter spirit.

EasterWorkbench.name: Easter Workbench
EasterWorkbench.description: This small working table contains the right materials to create a selection of spring and Easter-themed decorations.

HalloweenGoodieBag.name: Samhain Goodie Bag
HalloweenGoodieBag.description: A bag full of spooky sweets and secrets. Pop it up to peek inside.

PumpkinCoin.name: Pumpkin Coin
PumpkinCoin.description: A mischievous-looking coin that can be traded for various, eerie goods.

EerieFloor.name: Eerie Floor
EerieFloor.description: Dark floor boards trodden for many years by unholy feet.

EerieTable.name: Eerie Table
EerieTable.description: An old table that was used to serve horrible dishes. The presence of those who devoured them still lingers.

EerieStool.name: Eerie Stool
EerieStool.description: A seating opportunity made from cursed wood, ready to scare your buttocks off.

EerieDresser.name: Eerie Dresser
EerieDresser.description: Years of misuse turned this dresser into what it is now. Hopefully it treats your clothes better.

EerieChest.name: Eerie Chest
EerieChest.description: A creaking chest, useful for storing belongings. There are faint growling noises that can be heard from inside.

EerieTreeLight.name: Twisted Roots Torch
EerieTreeLight.description: A torch that stands like an eerie beacon in the darkness of the caves.

EerieRug.name: Eerie Rug
EerieRug.description: An old rug with a mysterious sigil. A witness of too many séances.

CandleStack.name: Candle Stack
CandleStack.description: A set of candles for your decoration needs or the right atmosphere when summoning evil entities.

ChristmasPresent.name: Winter Present
ChristmasPresent.description: A mysterious gift with unknown contents. Rip it open and peek inside!

ChristmasWallDecorationA.name: Winter Wreath Wall Decoration
ChristmasWallDecorationA.description: This simple wreath will do nicely on any wall and show visitors that it's finally holiday.

ChristmasWallDecorationB.name: Holiday Sock Wall Decoration
ChristmasWallDecorationB.description: A cozy sock to put on the wall. By tradition these were filled with small trinkets and candy.

ChristmasWallDecorationC.name: Candy Cane Wall Decoration
ChristmasWallDecorationC.description: Two crossed candy canes that are rather for decoration, not consumption. Put them on the wall for a nice winter flair.

ChristmasWallDecorationD.name: Winter Candle Wall Decoration
ChristmasWallDecorationD.description: Two wintry candles sitting on a candle dish, made to be put on the wall. Careful with the fire, though.

ChristmasWallDecorationE.name: Snowflake Wall Decoration
ChristmasWallDecorationE.description: A delicate snowflake that will look great on the walls of your home.

ChristmasLuxuryPresent.name: Luxury Winter Present
ChristmasLuxuryPresent.description: A mysterious golden gift with unknown contents. Rip it open and peek inside!

ChristmasTree.name: Decorated Winter Tree
ChristmasTree.description: Celebrating the cold season is not complete without setting up one of these. The centerpoint of every well-decorated lawn or living room.

ChristmasTable.name: Festive Table
ChristmasTable.description: This big table serves as a nice basis to set up a great dinner and bring the family together.

ChristmasStool.name: Festive Stool
ChristmasStool.description: A nice little stool that goes well with a richly decorated table. It's hard to sit still on it when opening presents is due.

ChristmasFireplace.name: Festive Fireplace
ChristmasFireplace.description: This fireplace is a great addition to every base when it's cold outside. Crackling fire and the smell of burning wood add to a homely atmosphere.

ChristmasSnowman.name: Snowman
ChristmasSnowman.description: A cold fellow that came into existence by stacking large snowballs together. Keep it around to not feel as lonely anymore.

SnowballPyramid.name: Snowball Pyramid
SnowballPyramid.description: A traditional festive contruct built with snowballs and a light source in the middle.

Candle.name: Candle
Candle.description: This simple decorative candle can be placed anywhere to set up a cozy atmosphere.

ChristmasLightDecorationMix.name: Festive Wall Lights
ChristmasLightDecorationMix.description: A mix of colorful lights to decorate the walls with.

ChristmasLightDecorationPaintable.name: Paintable Festive Wall Lights
ChristmasLightDecorationPaintable.description: Small colorful lights to decorate the walls with.

ValentinePresent.name: Valentine's Gift
ValentinePresent.description: This rose and silver-colored gift is packed with a variety of different charming items.

ValentineLetter.name: Love Letter
ValentineLetter.description: A scented letter that contains words of love and appreciation. Give it to someone in dire need of affection.

ValentineRug.name: Heart-shaped Rug
ValentineRug.description: Nothing speaks "love" like a big fuzzy heart on the floor. It smells like wool and lavender.

ValentineCandles.name: Valentine's Candles
ValentineCandles.description: A handful of small, pink candles that fill the air with a whiff of vanille.

ValentineWallHearts.name: Wall Hearts
ValentineWallHearts.description: An assortment of hearts cut from paper, they look great on walls and make a base just a little bit more lovely.

ValentinePainting.name: Heart Painting
ValentinePainting.description: A simple painting showing nothing more than a heart. Sometimes this is all one needs in these dark times.

ValentinePlushie.name: Caveling Brute Plushie
ValentinePlushie.description: A big plushie, resembling a caveling brute holding a heart. Even those need a little bit of love sometimes.

AnniversaryPartyHatGreen.name: Green Party Hat
AnniversaryPartyHatGreen.description: This groovy green party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

AnniversaryPartyHatRed.name: Red Party Hat
AnniversaryPartyHatRed.description: This radical red party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

AnniversaryPartyHatBlue.name: Blue Party Hat
AnniversaryPartyHatBlue.description: This blazing blue party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

AnniversaryPartyHatPurple.name: Purple Party Hat
AnniversaryPartyHatPurple.description: This perky purple party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

AnniversaryCake.name: Anniversary Cake
AnniversaryCake.description: Drenched in blue glaze and stuck with candles, this glow tulip chocolate cake marks a special anniversary.

WhiteCherryFlower.name: White Cherry Blossom
WhiteCherryFlower.description: A silky white blossom that fell from a beautiful tree. In full bloom it has a faint almond fragrance and reminds one of the joys of life.

PinkCherryFlower.name: Pink Cherry Blossom
PinkCherryFlower.description: A vibrant pink blossom that fell from a "weeping" tree. Its short-lived blooming period reminds one of the transcience of life.

WhiteCherryTree.name: White Cherry Tree
WhiteCherryTree.description: This beautiful white tree is a traditional symbol of the joys of life. It is said that in spring a fairy maiden descends to awake the sleeping cherry trees with her breath.

PinkCherryTree.name: Pink Cherry Tree
PinkCherryTree.description: This "weeping" tree holds its branches low, letting the blossoms droop towards the ground. It is said that brave warriors took depictions of those trees with them into their final battle.

ChineseLantern.name: Paper Lantern
ChineseLantern.description: A cozy light that can create a warm atmosphere in any room. It even comes in different colors.

RedEnvelope.name: Red Envelope
RedEnvelope.description: A gift to symbolize good wishes and luck for the year ahead. Someone left it for you to open.

ChineseGuardianLion.name: Guardian Beast Statue
ChineseGuardianLion.description: An imposing monument to be placed in front of entrances, meant to keep figures with ill intent away.

ChineseKnot.name: Mystic Knot Tassel
ChineseKnot.description: Woven from woolen string, this decoration symbolizes good luck, prosperity and abundance.

ChineseWallLantern.name: Wall Paper Lantern
ChineseWallLantern.description: A set of small lanterns that go nicely on the walls. Just like their bigger counterparts, they exist in many different colors.

DragonMaskHelm.name: Dragon Mask
DragonMaskHelm.description: An intimidating but well-meaning mask that invokes the spirit of mythological dragons.

ChineseCoin.name: Lucky Coin
ChineseCoin.description: While this golden coin holds many favorable meanings, the most important one is that it can be spent at a certain merchant.

ChineseFoldingScreen.name: Folding Screen
ChineseFoldingScreen.description: A stylish set of panels. Great for dividing spaces or hiding your secret stash.

LuckyCat.name: Lucky Cat
LuckyCat.description: When powered by electricity, this ceramic charmer waves its paw as if to say, "Fortune favors the feline!"

MeadowTree.name: Meadow Tree
MeadowTree.description: The tranquility of the meadow produced a Lush Tree variant that grows golden-colored leafs. Plant it back into the ground to decorate your home.

MeadowBush.name: Meadow Bush
MeadowBush.description: A golden-colored patch of meadow grass to use as a decorative.

MeadowTallGrass.name: Tall Meadow Grass
MeadowTallGrass.description: A large golden-colored patch of tall meadow grass to use as a decorative.

PottedEnvelopeTree.name: Potted Tree with Red Envelopes
PottedEnvelopeTree.description: A small tree in a pot with decorative red envelopes hanging from the branches.

AtlantianWormRing.name: Atlantean Worm Ring
AtlantianWormRing.description: An organic ring that looks like one of the segments of the Atlantean Worm. It must have grown inside its body as an anomaly.

CrystalRing.name: Glass Bead Ring
CrystalRing.description: A captivating ring that catches your enemies off-guard so that they lower their defense. Unfortunately it has the same effect on you.

HydraJewelryNatureRing.name: Druidra's Ring
HydraJewelryNatureRing.description: A leafy ring that imbues the holder with powers of the poisonous nature.

HydraJewelrySeaRing.name: Crydra's Ring
HydraJewelrySeaRing.description: An icy ring that imbues the holder with powers of the cold elements.

CrescentRing.name: Crescent Ring
CrescentRing.description: Allows the bearer to reach further sources of wisdom.

HourglassRing.name: Hourglass Ring
HourglassRing.description: Has a small hourglass on top. The sand within has stopped flowing down.

ViciousRing.name: Vicious Ring
ViciousRing.description: The unsettling gaze of this ring causes minions to stay on high alert.

BoundaryRing.name: Boundary Ring
BoundaryRing.description: A simple ring that forms a magical veil.

PuppetRing.name: Puppet Ring
PuppetRing.description: An odd, ornate ring. You feel a closer bond with your minions whilst wearing it.

ExcavationBurnerRing.name: Aether Ring
ExcavationBurnerRing.description: A ring with tiny sconces that come ablaze with purple flames when you wear it.

ExcavationScrewNutRing.name: Helical Ring
ExcavationScrewNutRing.description: A nut fastener just the right size for your finger.

MakeAWishHat.name: Make-A-Wish Hat
MakeAWishHat.description: A glimmering party hat for a generous heart. The caves feel a little less dark, and the world a little less gloomy thanks to your charity.

ContributorItem0.name: Pug Plushie
ContributorItem0.description: Its paws hold a small gamepad, and its large pupils glimmer with gratitude. A tag underneath reads, "Thank you, Präntare".

ContributorItemDaresielSword.name: Splintered Wooden Sword
ContributorItemDaresielSword.description: This simple sword has seen far more battles than its maker would ever suggest. A worn reminder that even the humblest blade can do the impossible, where every crack Dares the next blow to land.

ContributorItemDakonHat.name: The Mad Hat
ContributorItemDakonHat.description: A once-ordinary hat now stuffed with scribbled notes, maps, and theories about the underground. Listen closely, and it might just share a helpful hint or two.

ContributorItemOwlunaeBook.name: Pictographic Sketchbook
ContributorItemOwlunaeBook.description: A charming and colorful notebook filled with owl-like doodles of cavelings mining, dancing, and one brute bonking its own head with a stick.

ContributorItem1.name: Keeper's Throne
ContributorItem1.description: A core governing seat with traces of dog hairs. Fit for a keeper of both cores and pugs.
